lpp.ach_return.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ach_return.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each ACH return record.

lpp.ach_return.original_transfer_ref.name: original_transfer_ref
lpp.ach_return.original_transfer_ref.description: Reference identifier of the original ACH transfer that was returned, linking the return to its source payment.

lpp.ach_return.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ach_return.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group that owns the returned ACH transaction, such as GR_US_INC for the US incorporated entity or GR_TREASURY for the treasury entity.

lpp.ach_return.business_unit_code.name: business_unit_code
lpp.ach_return.business_unit_code.description: Code identifying the business unit responsible for the returned ACH transaction, such as BU_TREAS for the treasury unit or BU_US_IN for the US incorporated business unit.
value_aliases: BU_USINC_PAYROLL -> Business Unit US Inc Payroll

lpp.ach_return.return_date.name: return_date
lpp.ach_return.return_date.description: The calendar date on which the ACH return was received or processed.

lpp.ach_return.return_reason_code.name: return_reason_code
lpp.ach_return.return_reason_code.description: Standardized NACHA return reason code indicating why the ACH transaction was returned, such as R01 for insufficient funds or R29 for corporate customer advises not authorized.
value_aliases: R03 -> No Account / Unable to Locate Account
R10 -> Customer Advises Originator Not Known / Not Authorized
R29 -> Corporate Customer Advises Not Authorized

lpp.ach_return.return_category.name: return_category
lpp.ach_return.return_category.description: Business grouping of the return reason, classifying returns into broad categories such as insufficient funds, invalid account, unauthorized, or other.

lpp.ach_return.direction.name: direction
lpp.ach_return.direction.description: Indicates the flow direction of the returned ACH transaction; currently only debit returns are recorded.

lpp.ach_return.amount.name: amount
lpp.ach_return.amount.description: The monetary value of the returned ACH transaction in the transaction's currency.

lpp.ach_return.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ach_return.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code denoting the currency of the returned ACH transaction, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.

lpp.ach_return.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.ach_return.bank_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the specific bank account associated with the returned ACH transaction, such as GR_CA_PAYROLL_1 for the Canada payroll account or IHB_AUD_CONCENTRATION for the AUD concentration account.

lpp.ach_return.resolved.name: resolved
lpp.ach_return.resolved.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the ACH return has been resolved or actioned by the operations team.

lpp.acquirer.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each acquirer record.

lpp.acquirer.code.name: code
lpp.acquirer.code.description: Short internal code used to identify a payment acquirer, such as ADYEN, STRIPE, or FIS_WORLDPAY.
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer.name.name: name
lpp.acquirer.name.description: Full legal or trading name of the payment acquirer, such as Adyen NV or JPMorgan Chase Merchant Services.

lpp.acquirer.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.acquirer.bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the sponsoring or partner bank associated with the acquirer, present only for bank-affiliated acquirers.

lpp.acquirer.settlement_account_ref.name: settlement_account_ref
lpp.acquirer.settlement_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the internal operating account into which settlement funds from this acquirer are deposited.

lpp.acquirer.region.name: region
lpp.acquirer.region.description: Geographic region in which the acquirer primarily operates, such as AMER (Americas) or EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa).

lpp.acquirer.is_strategic.name: is_strategic
lpp.acquirer.is_strategic.description: Flag indicating whether this acquirer is classified as a strategic partner for the business.

lpp.acquirer.onboarded_date.name: onboarded_date
lpp.acquirer.onboarded_date.description: The date on which the acquirer was formally onboarded and activated for use in payment processing.

lpp.acquirer_contract.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer_contract.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each acquirer contract record.

lpp.acquirer_contract.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.acquirer_contract.acquirer_ref.description: Code identifying the payment acquirer or processor party to the contract (e.g., ADYEN, STRIPE, FIS_WORLDPAY).
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer_contract.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.acquirer_contract.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity of the company that holds the acquirer contract (e.g., GR_US_INC, GR_EU_BV).

lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_from.description: Date on which the acquirer contract becomes or became effective.

lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_to.description: Date on which the acquirer contract expires or is scheduled to end; null indicates an open-ended contract.

lpp.acquirer_contract.contract_status.name: contract_status
lpp.acquirer_contract.contract_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the acquirer contract (e.g., ACTIVE).

lpp.acquirer_contract.processor_margin_b.name: processor_margin_bps
lpp.acquirer_contract.processor_margin_b.description: The acquirer's processing margin charged to the merchant, expressed in basis points.

lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_am.name: monthly_minimum_amount
lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_am.description: Minimum monthly fee amount committed to the acquirer under the contract terms.

lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_cu.name: monthly_minimum_currency
lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_cu.description: ISO currency code in which the monthly minimum fee amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_lag_bus.name: settlement_lag_business_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_lag_bus.description: Number of business days between transaction processing and when funds are received from the acquirer.

lpp.acquirer_contract.uptime_sla_pct.name: uptime_sla_pct
lpp.acquirer_contract.uptime_sla_pct.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum uptime percentage for the acquirer's payment processing service.

lpp.acquirer_contract.auth_response_sla_.name: auth_response_sla_ms
lpp.acquirer_contract.auth_response_sla_.description: Maximum authorization response time in milliseconds guaranteed by the acquirer under the contract SLA.

lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_sla_bus.name: settlement_sla_business_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_sla_bus.description: Maximum number of business days within which the acquirer is contractually obligated to settle funds.

lpp.acquirer_contract.renewal_notice_day.name: renewal_notice_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.renewal_notice_day.description: Number of days advance notice required before contract expiry to trigger or prevent renewal.

lpp.acquirer_contract.auto_renew.name: auto_renew
lpp.acquirer_contract.auto_renew.description: Flag indicating whether the acquirer contract automatically renews at the end of its term.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each SLA metric record for deduplication and reference purposes.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.acquirer_ref.description: Standardized code identifying the payment acquirer or processor (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv) whose SLA performance is being measured.
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.measurement_date.name: measurement_date
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.measurement_date.description: The calendar date on which the SLA metrics for the acquirer were recorded or evaluated.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.auth_rate_pct.name: auth_rate_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.auth_rate_pct.description: The percentage of payment authorization attempts that were successfully approved by the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.avg_response_tim.name: avg_response_time_ms
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.avg_response_tim.description: The average time in milliseconds taken by the acquirer to respond to transaction authorization requests on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.settlement_on_ti.name: settlement_on_time_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.settlement_on_ti.description: The percentage of settlements completed by the acquirer within the contractually agreed timeframe on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uptime_pct.name: uptime_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uptime_pct.description: The percentage of time the acquirer's payment processing systems were operational and available on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.sla_breach_count.name: sla_breach_count
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.sla_breach_count.description: The number of SLA contractual violations recorded for the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.incident_count.name: incident_count
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.incident_count.description: The number of operational incidents or service disruptions recorded for the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.ap_invoice.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ap_invoice.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each accounts payable invoice record.

lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_number.name: invoice_number
lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_number.description: Human-readable business reference number assigned to each accounts payable invoice, formatted as AP-XXXXXXXX.

lpp.ap_invoice.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ap_invoice.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group that owns the invoice, such as GR_CA for the Canadian entity or GR_TREASURY for the treasury entity.

lpp.ap_invoice.vendor_ref.name: vendor_ref
lpp.ap_invoice.vendor_ref.description: Code identifying the supplier or vendor who issued the invoice, with the prefix indicating the spend category such as CAPEX, IT, or MKTG.

lpp.ap_invoice.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.ap_invoice.issue_date.description: The date on which the vendor issued the invoice.

lpp.ap_invoice.due_date.name: due_date
lpp.ap_invoice.due_date.description: The date by which the invoice must be paid according to agreed payment terms.

lpp.ap_invoice.paid_date.name: paid_date
lpp.ap_invoice.paid_date.description: The date on which the invoice was fully paid; null indicates the invoice has not yet been fully paid.

lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_amount.name: invoice_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_amount.description: The total gross amount billed on the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.paid_amount.name: paid_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.paid_amount.description: The total amount that has been paid against the invoice to date in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.open_amount.name: open_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.open_amount.description: The remaining unpaid balance on the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ap_invoice.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice amounts are denominated, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.

lpp.ap_invoice.status.name: status
lpp.ap_invoice.status.description: The current payment status of the invoice, indicating whether it is fully paid, open, partially paid, or under dispute.

lpp.ap_invoice.payment_terms.name: payment_terms
lpp.ap_invoice.payment_terms.description: The agreed payment terms specifying when the invoice is due, such as NET_30 for payment within 30 days or EOM_5 for payment 5 days after end of month.

lpp.app_user.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.app_user.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each application user record.

lpp.app_user.code.name: code
lpp.app_user.code.description: Functional role code assigned to the user, representing their job function or access profile within the treasury and finance application (e.g., TREAS_FRONT, CFO_GLOBAL, FX_TRADER).

lpp.app_user.first_name.name: first_name
lpp.app_user.first_name.description: Given (first) name of the application user.

lpp.app_user.last_name.name: last_name
lpp.app_user.last_name.description: Family (last) name or surname of the application user.

lpp.app_user.email.name: email
lpp.app_user.email.description: Corporate email address of the application user, following the firstname.lastname@globalretail.com format.

lpp.app_user.active.name: active
lpp.app_user.active.description: Flag indicating whether the user account is currently active and enabled in the application.

lpp.ar_invoice.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ar_invoice.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each accounts receivable invoice record.

lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_number.name: invoice_number
lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_number.description: Human-readable invoice reference code that encodes the sales channel, issuing entity, and invoice date (e.g., AR-B2C-GR_APAC_PTE-20230501).

lpp.ar_invoice.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ar_invoice.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary of the group that issued the invoice (e.g., GR_DE for Germany, GR_APAC_PTE for APAC).

lpp.ar_invoice.customer_ref.name: customer_ref
lpp.ar_invoice.customer_ref.description: Code identifying the customer billed on the invoice, distinguishing retail consumers from named third-party customers (e.g., RETAIL_CONSUMER, TP_CUST_0015).

lpp.ar_invoice.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.ar_invoice.issue_date.description: The date on which the invoice was formally issued to the customer.

lpp.ar_invoice.due_date.name: due_date
lpp.ar_invoice.due_date.description: The date by which payment of the invoice is expected from the customer.

lpp.ar_invoice.paid_date.name: paid_date
lpp.ar_invoice.paid_date.description: The date on which the invoice was fully paid; null if payment has not yet been received.

lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_amount.name: invoice_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_amount.description: The total monetary amount billed to the customer on the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ar_invoice.paid_amount.name: paid_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.paid_amount.description: The monetary amount that has been collected or paid against the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ar_invoice.open_amount.name: open_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.open_amount.description: The outstanding monetary balance still owed on the invoice (invoice amount minus paid amount) in the invoice currency.

lpp.ar_invoice.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ar_invoice.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the invoice amounts are denominated (e.g., EUR, USD, JPY).

lpp.ar_invoice.status.name: status
lpp.ar_invoice.status.description: The current collection status of the invoice, indicating whether it has been paid, remains open, or has been written off.

lpp.ar_invoice.payment_terms.name: payment_terms
lpp.ar_invoice.payment_terms.description: The agreed payment terms specifying the number of days from invoice issue date within which the customer must pay (e.g., NET_30 means payment due within 30 days).

lpp.audit_trail.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.audit_trail.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each audit trail record.

lpp.audit_trail.entity_type.name: entity_type
lpp.audit_trail.entity_type.description: The category of business entity that was acted upon, such as a bank account, hedge relationship, liquidity policy, or transfer.

lpp.audit_trail.entity_code.name: entity_code
lpp.audit_trail.entity_code.description: The business code or reference identifier of the specific entity instance that was acted upon, such as a named bank account or hedge relationship.

lpp.audit_trail.action.name: action
lpp.audit_trail.action.description: The type of operation performed on the entity, indicating whether it was created, updated, or approved.

lpp.audit_trail.actor_user.name: actor_user
lpp.audit_trail.actor_user.description: The user or role that performed the action on the entity, such as a treasury administrator or CFO.

lpp.audit_trail.occurred_at.name: occurred_at
lpp.audit_trail.occurred_at.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which the audit event took place.

lpp.audit_trail.before_image.name: before_image
lpp.audit_trail.before_image.description: A structured snapshot of the entity's full state immediately before the action was applied, enabling comparison of what changed.

lpp.audit_trail.after_image.name: after_image
lpp.audit_trail.after_image.description: A structured snapshot of the entity's full state immediately after the action was applied, representing the resulting record.

lpp.bank.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each bank record.

lpp.bank.code.name: code
lpp.bank.code.description: Internal business code used to identify a bank, such as BANK_JPM for JPMorgan Chase or BANK_HSBC for HSBC.

lpp.bank.interface_code.name: interface_code
lpp.bank.interface_code.description: System interface code used to identify the bank in external integrations or data feeds, typically matching the internal bank code.

lpp.bank.external_code.name: external_code
lpp.bank.external_code.description: External reference code assigned to the bank by a third-party system or counterparty.

lpp.bank.description1.name: description1
lpp.bank.description1.description: Primary human-readable name of the bank, such as JPMorgan Chase or BNP Paribas.

lpp.bank.description2.name: description2
lpp.bank.description2.description: Secondary or supplementary description of the bank, providing additional naming detail.

lpp.bank.bic.name: bic
lpp.bank.bic.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC/SWIFT code) used internationally to identify the bank for payment routing, such as CHASUS33 for JPMorgan Chase.

lpp.bank.lei.name: lei
lpp.bank.lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) assigned to the bank for regulatory and compliance purposes.

lpp.bank.url_address.name: url_address
lpp.bank.url_address.description: Website URL for the bank's online portal or public web presence.

lpp.bank.contact.name: contact
lpp.bank.contact.description: Contact information for the bank relationship, such as a representative name or contact details.

lpp.bank.intercompany.name: intercompany
lpp.bank.intercompany.description: Flag indicating whether the bank is an intercompany entity within the same corporate group.

lpp.bank.internal_counterparty.name: internal_counterparty
lpp.bank.internal_counterparty.description: Flag indicating whether the bank is treated as an internal counterparty for treasury or dealing purposes.

lpp.bank.counter_party_info.name: counter_party_info
lpp.bank.counter_party_info.description: Flag indicating whether counterparty information is required or available for transactions with this bank.

lpp.bank.intermediary_info.name: intermediary_info
lpp.bank.intermediary_info.description: Flag indicating whether intermediary bank information is required for payments to this bank.

lpp.bank.net_settlements.name: net_settlements
lpp.bank.net_settlements.description: Flag indicating whether settlements with this bank are processed on a net basis rather than gross.

lpp.bank.net_debit_and_credit_exposure.name: net_debit_and_credit_exposure
lpp.bank.net_debit_and_credit_exposure.description: Flag indicating whether debit and credit exposures are netted together when calculating total exposure to this bank.

lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_amount.name: cash_exposure_limit_amount
lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_amount.description: Maximum allowable cash exposure amount permitted with this bank, expressed in the cash exposure limit currency.

lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_currency.name: cash_exposure_limit_currency
lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_currency.description: Currency in which the cash exposure limit amount is denominated, currently USD across all records.

lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_pct.name: cash_exposure_limit_pct
lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_pct.description: Maximum allowable cash exposure expressed as a percentage of a reference base, such as total portfolio or credit line.

lpp.bank.deal_identifier.name: deal_identifier
lpp.bank.deal_identifier.description: Format or scheme used to identify deals associated with this bank counterparty.

lpp.bank.fx_confirmation_method.name: fx_confirmation_method
lpp.bank.fx_confirmation_method.description: Method used to confirm foreign exchange transactions with this bank, such as electronic messaging or manual confirmation.

lpp.bank.loan_confirmation_method.name: loan_confirmation_method
lpp.bank.loan_confirmation_method.description: Method used to confirm loan transactions with this bank counterparty.

lpp.bank.risk_tier_ref.name: risk_tier_ref
lpp.bank.risk_tier_ref.description: Risk tier classification assigned to the bank, ranging from TIER_1 (lowest risk) to TIER_3 (highest risk).

lpp.bank.parent_counterparty_ref.name: parent_counterparty_ref
lpp.bank.parent_counterparty_ref.description: Reference to the parent counterparty entity of this bank, used to group subsidiaries under a common parent.

lpp.bank.default_group_ref.name: default_group_ref
lpp.bank.default_group_ref.description: Reference to the default counterparty group this bank belongs to for grouping or reporting purposes.

lpp.bank.third_party_ref.name: third_party_ref
lpp.bank.third_party_ref.description: Reference to a third-party entity or system associated with this bank.

lpp.bank.address.name: address
lpp.bank.address.description: Structured address details for the bank, stored as a JSON or semi-structured object.

lpp.bank.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.bank.user_zones.description: User-defined zone or access control assignments for this bank record, stored as a structured object.

lpp.bank_account.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_account.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each bank account record.

lpp.bank_account.code.name: code
lpp.bank_account.code.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying a bank account, typically combining the company entity, country, and account purpose (e.g., GR_AE_COLLECTION_1).

lpp.bank_account.description.name: description
lpp.bank_account.description.description: Human-readable label for the bank account, combining the company entity and account purpose (e.g., GR_AE COLLECTION Account).

lpp.bank_account.description2.name: description2
lpp.bank_account.description2.description: Secondary free-text description field for additional account labelling or notes.

lpp.bank_account.account_type.name: account_type
lpp.bank_account.account_type.description: Classification of the account record type, indicating it is a bank account (e.g., BANK_ACCOUNT).

lpp.bank_account.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.bank_account.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 currency code denoting the native currency in which the bank account is denominated (e.g., AED, AUD, EUR).

lpp.bank_account.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.bank_account.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that owns the bank account (e.g., GR_AE, GR_AU, GR_TREASURY).

lpp.bank_account.branch_ref.name: branch_ref
lpp.bank_account.branch_ref.description: Code identifying the banking institution branch where the account is held (e.g., BR_IHB_LDN, BR_CITI_NY).

lpp.bank_account.default_group_ref.name: default_group_ref
lpp.bank_account.default_group_ref.description: Reference to the default grouping or pool to which the bank account is assigned for cash management purposes.

lpp.bank_account.bank_account_id.name: bank_account_id
lpp.bank_account.bank_account_id.description: Structured JSON or semi-structured object storing one or more external bank-assigned account identifiers (e.g., IBAN, account number).

lpp.bank_account.bank_account_ids.name: bank_account_ids
lpp.bank_account.bank_account_ids.description: Structured JSON or semi-structured object storing a collection of all external identifiers associated with the bank account across different payment schemes.

lpp.bank_account.address.name: address
lpp.bank_account.address.description: Structured JSON or semi-structured object containing the postal address associated with the bank account.

lpp.bank_account.contact.name: contact
lpp.bank_account.contact.description: Structured JSON or semi-structured object containing contact details (e.g., phone, email) for the bank account relationship.

lpp.bank_account.calendar_ref.name: calendar_ref
lpp.bank_account.calendar_ref.description: Reference to the business calendar used for determining valid banking days for this account (e.g., STANDARD).

lpp.bank_account.time_zone.name: time_zone
lpp.bank_account.time_zone.description: Time zone used for cut-off time calculations and transaction processing for the bank account (e.g., UTC).

lpp.bank_account.cut_off_time.name: cut_off_time
lpp.bank_account.cut_off_time.description: The daily deadline time by which payment instructions must be submitted to the bank for same-day processing.

lpp.bank_account.opening_date.name: opening_date
lpp.bank_account.opening_date.description: The date on which the bank account was officially opened.

lpp.bank_account.closing_date.name: closing_date
lpp.bank_account.closing_date.description: The date on which the bank account was or is scheduled to be closed.

lpp.bank_account.closed_account.name: closed_account
lpp.bank_account.closed_account.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the bank account has been closed and is no longer active.

lpp.bank_account.hidden.name: hidden
lpp.bank_account.hidden.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the bank account is hidden from standard views and reporting.

lpp.bank_account.non_resident.name: non_resident
lpp.bank_account.non_resident.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the bank account is held by a non-resident entity for regulatory or tax classification purposes.

lpp.bank_account.bank_statement_layout.name: bank_statement_layout
lpp.bank_account.bank_statement_layout.description: Identifier for the format or template used to parse incoming bank statement files for this account.

lpp.bank_account.integrate_end_of_day_st.name: integrate_end_of_day_statements
lpp.bank_account.integrate_end_of_day_st.description: Boolean flag indicating whether end-of-day bank statements are automatically imported and integrated for this account.

lpp.bank_account.integrate_intraday_stat.name: integrate_intraday_statements
lpp.bank_account.integrate_intraday_stat.description: Boolean flag indicating whether intraday bank statements are automatically imported and integrated for this account.

lpp.bank_account.consider_one_day_float_.name: consider_one_day_float_transactions
lpp.bank_account.consider_one_day_float_.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transactions with a one-day float (value date offset) are included in cash position calculations.

lpp.bank_account.consider_two_day_float_.name: consider_two_day_float_transactions
lpp.bank_account.consider_two_day_float_.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transactions with a two-day float are included in cash position calculations.

lpp.bank_account.consider_three_day_floa.name: consider_three_day_float_transactions
lpp.bank_account.consider_three_day_floa.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transactions with a three-day float are included in cash position calculations.

lpp.bank_account.consider_investment_pos.name: consider_investment_position_transactions
lpp.bank_account.consider_investment_pos.description: Boolean flag indicating whether investment position transactions are included in the cash position for this account.

lpp.bank_account.consider_bank_statement.name: consider_bank_statements_from
lpp.bank_account.consider_bank_statement.description: The earliest date from which bank statements should be considered when computing balances or reconciliations for this account.

lpp.bank_account.zba_generator.name: zba_generator
lpp.bank_account.zba_generator.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is a master or header account that generates zero-balance accounting (ZBA) sweeps.

lpp.bank_account.zba_identifier.name: zba_identifier
lpp.bank_account.zba_identifier.description: Code or label identifying this account's role or membership within a zero-balance accounting (ZBA) cash pooling structure.

lpp.bank_account.generate_zba_flow.name: generate_zba_flow
lpp.bank_account.generate_zba_flow.description: Configuration value specifying the method or frequency by which zero-balance accounting sweep flows are generated for this account.

lpp.bank_account.settlement_account_ref.name: settlement_account_ref
lpp.bank_account.settlement_account_ref.description: Reference to the account used for settling outgoing payment transactions initiated from this bank account.

lpp.bank_account_group.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_account_group.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each bank account group record.

lpp.bank_account_group.code.name: code
lpp.bank_account_group.code.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify and reference a bank account group within business processes.

lpp.bank_account_group.description.name: description
lpp.bank_account_group.description.description: Human-readable label or narrative that describes the purpose or nature of the bank account group.

lpp.bank_account_group_member.account_gr.name: account_group_code
lpp.bank_account_group_member.account_gr.description: The unique code identifying the bank account group to which a member belongs.

lpp.bank_account_group_member.bank_accou.name: bank_account_code
lpp.bank_account_group_member.bank_accou.description: The unique code identifying the individual bank account that is a member of the account group.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_account_signatory.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each bank account signatory record.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.bank_account_.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.bank_account_signatory.bank_account_.description: Business reference code identifying the specific bank account to which the signatory authority is assigned, typically encoding entity, country, and account purpose (e.g., GR_JP_OPERATING_1).

lpp.bank_account_signatory.user_ref.name: user_ref
lpp.bank_account_signatory.user_ref.description: Business role or user identifier representing the individual or role granted signatory authority on the bank account (e.g., CFO_GLOBAL, CASH_MANAGER_EMEA).

lpp.bank_account_signatory.role.name: role
lpp.bank_account_signatory.role.description: The signatory role assigned to the user on the bank account, indicating their level of authorization in the payment approval workflow (e.g., SIGNER_A, SIGNER_B, RELEASER).

lpp.bank_account_signatory.authority_lim.name: authority_limit_amount
lpp.bank_account_signatory.authority_lim.description: The maximum monetary amount up to which the signatory is authorized to approve or release transactions on the bank account.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.authority_lim.name: authority_limit_currency
lpp.bank_account_signatory.authority_lim.description: The ISO currency code in which the signatory's authority limit amount is denominated (e.g., EUR, USD, JPY).

lpp.bank_account_signatory.granted_date.name: granted_date
lpp.bank_account_signatory.granted_date.description: The date on which signatory authority was formally granted to the user for the specified bank account.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.last_recertif.name: last_recertified_date
lpp.bank_account_signatory.last_recertif.description: The most recent date on which the signatory's authority was reviewed and recertified as still valid.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.next_recertif.name: next_recertify_due_date
lpp.bank_account_signatory.next_recertif.description: The upcoming date by which the signatory's authority must be recertified to remain valid.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.status.name: status
lpp.bank_account_signatory.status.description: The current status of the signatory authority record, indicating whether the authorization is active or otherwise (e.g., ACTIVE).

lpp.bank_branch.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_branch.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each bank branch record.

lpp.bank_branch.code.name: code
lpp.bank_branch.code.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying a bank branch, combining bank abbreviation and city (e.g., BR_ANZ_SYD for ANZ Sydney).

lpp.bank_branch.interface_code.name: interface_code
lpp.bank_branch.interface_code.description: External-facing interface identifier for the branch used in system integrations, typically matching the internal branch code.

lpp.bank_branch.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.bank_branch.bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the parent bank institution that owns this branch (e.g., BANK_HSBC, BANK_JPM).

lpp.bank_branch.description.name: description
lpp.bank_branch.description.description: Human-readable name of the bank branch, combining the bank name and city location (e.g., Citi London, HSBC Hong Kong).

lpp.bank_branch.description2.name: description2
lpp.bank_branch.description2.description: Secondary descriptive label for the bank branch, currently unpopulated.

lpp.bank_branch.bic.name: bic
lpp.bank_branch.bic.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC/SWIFT code) used to uniquely identify the bank branch in international financial transactions (e.g., CITIGB2L, BNPAFRPPXXX).

lpp.bank_branch.corp_id_code.name: corp_id_code
lpp.bank_branch.corp_id_code.description: Corporate identifier code assigned to the bank branch for use in corporate banking contexts.

lpp.bank_branch.account_location.name: account_location
lpp.bank_branch.account_location.description: Physical or operational location descriptor associated with accounts held at this bank branch.

lpp.bank_branch.time_zone.name: time_zone
lpp.bank_branch.time_zone.description: IANA time zone identifier for the branch's operating location (e.g., Europe/London, Asia/Singapore).

lpp.bank_branch.cut_off_time.name: cut_off_time
lpp.bank_branch.cut_off_time.description: Daily cut-off time (in HH:MM format) by which transactions must be submitted to the branch for same-day processing.

lpp.bank_branch.calendar_ref.name: calendar_ref
lpp.bank_branch.calendar_ref.description: Reference to the business day calendar applied to this branch for settlement and processing date calculations.

lpp.bank_branch.intercompany.name: intercompany
lpp.bank_branch.intercompany.description: Flag indicating whether this branch is used for intercompany transactions within the same corporate group.

lpp.bank_branch.intermediary.name: intermediary
lpp.bank_branch.intermediary.description: Flag indicating whether this branch acts as an intermediary bank in payment routing.

lpp.bank_branch.main_country_branch.name: main_country_branch
lpp.bank_branch.main_country_branch.description: Flag indicating whether this branch is the primary branch for its country within the bank's network.

lpp.bank_branch.responder_code.name: responder_code
lpp.bank_branch.responder_code.description: Code identifying the system or entity designated to respond to messages or queries directed at this branch.

lpp.bank_branch.id_of_application.name: id_of_application
lpp.bank_branch.id_of_application.description: Identifier of the application or system associated with this bank branch for integration purposes.

lpp.bank_branch.service_name.name: service_name
lpp.bank_branch.service_name.description: Name of the banking service or channel through which this branch communicates or processes transactions.

lpp.bank_branch.interact_service_name.name: interact_service_name
lpp.bank_branch.interact_service_name.description: Name of the interactive or messaging service used by this branch for bank communications.

lpp.bank_branch.memo.name: memo
lpp.bank_branch.memo.description: Free-text notes or remarks associated with the bank branch record.

lpp.bank_branch.address.name: address
lpp.bank_branch.address.description: Structured JSON object containing the physical address details of the bank branch.

lpp.bank_branch.contact.name: contact
lpp.bank_branch.contact.description: Structured JSON object containing contact details (e.g., phone, email) for the bank branch.

lpp.bank_branch.other_identifier.name: other_identifier
lpp.bank_branch.other_identifier.description: Structured JSON object containing additional identifiers for the branch beyond the primary code and BIC.

lpp.bank_branch.user_zone.name: user_zone
lpp.bank_branch.user_zone.description: Structured JSON object containing user-defined or custom configuration attributes for the branch

lpp.bank_fee.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_fee.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each bank fee record.

lpp.bank_fee.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.bank_fee.bank_ref.description: Code identifying the bank that charged the fee, such as BANK_HSBC or BANK_JPM.

lpp.bank_fee.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.bank_fee.bank_account_ref.description: Code identifying the specific bank account against which the fee was charged, including country, entity, and account type (e.g. GR_GB_OPERATING_1, GR_FR_COLLECTION_1).

lpp.bank_fee.service_code.name: service_code
lpp.bank_fee.service_code.description: Numeric code identifying the type of banking service for which the fee was charged, such as account maintenance, transaction processing, or other service categories.

lpp.bank_fee.statement_period.name: statement_period
lpp.bank_fee.statement_period.description: The last day of the monthly billing period covered by the bank fee statement (e.g. 2024-07-31 represents July 2024).

lpp.bank_fee.charge_date.name: charge_date
lpp.bank_fee.charge_date.description: The actual date on which the bank fee was debited from the account.

lpp.bank_fee.units.name: units
lpp.bank_fee.units.description: The number of service units consumed during the statement period that the fee is based on (e.g. number of transactions or items processed).

lpp.bank_fee.charged_amount.name: charged_amount
lpp.bank_fee.charged_amount.description: The actual monetary amount charged by the bank for the service during the statement period.

lpp.bank_fee.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.bank_fee.currency_code.description: ISO currency code in which all fee amounts are expressed; currently always USD.

lpp.bank_fee.cash_flow_ref.name: cash_flow_ref
lpp.bank_fee.cash_flow_ref.description: Unique identifier linking the bank fee to its corresponding cash flow record for reconciliation purposes.

lpp.bank_fee.rate_card_ref.name: rate_card_ref
lpp.bank_fee.rate_card_ref.description: Unique identifier of the negotiated rate card used to calculate the expected fee for this service.

lpp.bank_fee.expected_amount.name: expected_amount
lpp.bank_fee.expected_amount.description: The fee amount expected based on the negotiated rate card, used as a benchmark to compare against the actual charged amount.

lpp.bank_fee.overage_amount.name: overage_amount
lpp.bank_fee.overage_amount.description: The monetary difference between the actual charged amount and the expected amount, representing fees charged in excess of the negotiated rate.

lpp.bank_fee.flagged.name: flagged
lpp.bank_fee.flagged.description: Boolean indicator that marks a bank fee record as requiring review or investigation, typically due to a discrepancy or anomaly.

lpp.bank_group.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_group.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each bank group record.

lpp.bank_group.code.name: code
lpp.bank_group.code.description: Short alphanumeric code used to uniquely identify and reference a bank group within the system.

lpp.bank_group.description.name: description
lpp.bank_group.description.description: Human-readable name or description providing the full label of the bank group.

lpp.bank_group_member.bank_group_code.name: bank_group_code
lpp.bank_group_member.bank_group_code.description: The unique code identifying the bank group to which a member bank belongs.

lpp.bank_group_member.bank_code.name: bank_code
lpp.bank_group_member.bank_code.description: The unique code identifying an individual bank that is a member of a bank group.

lpp.bank_service_type.code.name: code
lpp.bank_service_type.code.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to each bank service type (e.g., '100' for Account Maintenance, 'AAA' for specialized services).

lpp.bank_service_type.description.name: description
lpp.bank_service_type.description.description: Human-readable name of the bank service, such as 'Wire Out Domestic', 'ACH Credit', or 'Positive Pay Service', used for display and reporting purposes.

lpp.bank_service_type.category.name: category
lpp.bank_service_type.category.description: Broad functional grouping of the bank service type, such as 'WIRE_OUT', 'ACH', 'FX', or 'CASH_VAULT', used to aggregate related services for analysis and pricing.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_statement_balance.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each bank statement balance record for deduplication and audit purposes.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.bank_statement_balance.account_ref.description: Structured reference code identifying a specific bank account by entity, country, and account purpose (e.g., collection, operating, concentration, or investment).

lpp.bank_statement_balance.statement_dat.name: statement_date
lpp.bank_statement_balance.statement_dat.description: The calendar date for which the bank statement balance is reported.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.balance_type.name: balance_type
lpp.bank_statement_balance.balance_type.description: Indicates whether the balance represents the opening, closing, or intraday position of the account for the statement date.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.amount.name: amount
lpp.bank_statement_balance.amount.description: The monetary balance of the bank account in its native currency for the given statement date and balance type.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.bank_statement_balance.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the account balance amount is denominated.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.source_file.name: source_file
lpp.bank_statement_balance.source_file.description: The name of the BAI-format bank feed file from which this balance record was ingested, typically stamped with the feed delivery date.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.quality_statu.name: quality_status
lpp.bank_statement_balance.quality_statu.description: Indicates whether the balance record passed or failed automated data quality validation checks upon ingestion.

lpp.benchmark_rate.benchmark_code.name: benchmark_code
lpp.benchmark_rate.benchmark_code.description: Unique code identifying the interest rate benchmark (e.g., SOFR, SONIA, EURIBOR_3M) used as a reference rate in financial instruments.
value_aliases: AUD_BBSW_3M -> Australian Bank Bill Swap Rate (3-month)
HONIA -> Hong Kong Overnight Index Average

lpp.benchmark_rate.rate_date.name: rate_date
lpp.benchmark_rate.rate_date.description: The calendar date on which the benchmark interest rate was published or observed.

lpp.benchmark_rate.tenor.name: tenor
lpp.benchmark_rate.tenor.description: The maturity or term of the benchmark rate, indicating the time horizon for which the rate applies (e.g., overnight, 1-month, 3-month).

lpp.benchmark_rate.rate.name: rate
lpp.benchmark_rate.rate.description: The annualised benchmark interest rate value expressed as a percentage for the given benchmark, date, and tenor.

lpp.benchmark_rate.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.benchmark_rate.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the benchmark rate is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.benchmark_rate.source.name: source
lpp.benchmark_rate.source.description: The data provider or origin from which the benchmark rate was sourced, currently always a central bank.

lpp.borrowing.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.borrowing.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual borrowing record.

lpp.borrowing.facility_ref.name: facility_ref
lpp.borrowing.facility_ref.description: Business code identifying the credit facility under which the borrowing was drawn, encoding facility type, currency, and size (e.g. CF_RCF_EUR_500M for a €500M revolving credit facility).

lpp.borrowing.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.borrowing.company_ref.description: Business code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that borrowed the funds (e.g. GR_GB for the Great Britain entity, GR_HOLDINGS for the group holding company).

lpp.borrowing.drawdown_date.name: drawdown_date
lpp.borrowing.drawdown_date.description: The calendar date on which the borrowing was drawn down from the facility.

lpp.borrowing.repayment_date.name: repayment_date
lpp.borrowing.repayment_date.description: The scheduled or actual calendar date on which the borrowing principal is due to be or was repaid.

lpp.borrowing.principal_amount.name: principal_amount
lpp.borrowing.principal_amount.description: The face value of the borrowing in the denomination currency at the time of drawdown.

lpp.borrowing.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.borrowing.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code denoting the denomination of the borrowing (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.borrowing.all_in_rate.name: all_in_rate
lpp.borrowing.all_in_rate.description: The total annualised interest rate applicable to the borrowing, expressed as a percentage and inclusive of margin and any reference rate (e.g. 6.75 represents 6.75%).

lpp.borrowing.status.name: status
lpp.borrowing.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the borrowing, indicating whether it remains outstanding or has been fully repaid.

lpp.brain_evaluation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.brain_evaluation.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each brain evaluation record.

lpp.brain_evaluation.user_code.name: user_code
lpp.brain_evaluation.user_code.description: Code identifying the user who submitted the query for brain evaluation.

lpp.brain_evaluation.query_text.name: query_text
lpp.brain_evaluation.query_text.description: The raw natural language or structured query submitted by the user for evaluation by the brain reasoning engine.

lpp.brain_evaluation.evaluated_at.name: evaluated_at
lpp.brain_evaluation.evaluated_at.description: Timestamp recording when the brain evaluation was performed.

lpp.brain_evaluation.facts_applied.name: facts_applied
lpp.brain_evaluation.facts_applied.description: Structured collection of knowledge facts that were applied during the brain reasoning evaluation process.

lpp.brain_evaluation.edges_traversed.name: edges_traversed
lpp.brain_evaluation.edges_traversed.description: Structured list of knowledge graph edges traversed during the reasoning evaluation.

lpp.brain_evaluation.flagged_conflicts.name: flagged_conflicts
lpp.brain_evaluation.flagged_conflicts.description: Structured collection of contradictions or conflicts identified in the knowledge base during the evaluation.

lpp.brain_evaluation.answer_summary.name: answer_summary
lpp.brain_evaluation.answer_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the answer or conclusion produced by the brain evaluation engine.

lpp.brain_evaluation.seed_facts.name: seed_facts
lpp.brain_evaluation.seed_facts.description: Structured set of initial facts used as the starting point for the brain reasoning evaluation.

lpp.brain_evaluation.retrieval_scores.name: retrieval_scores
lpp.brain_evaluation.retrieval_scores.description: Structured set of relevance or confidence scores assigned to facts retrieved during the evaluation.

lpp.brain_evaluation.expansion_hops.name: expansion_hops
lpp.brain_evaluation.expansion_hops.description: Number of hops or reasoning steps taken to expand from seed facts during the brain evaluation.

lpp.budget_code.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.budget_code.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each budget code record.

lpp.budget_code.code.name: code
lpp.budget_code.code.description: Short alphanumeric code representing a high-level budget category, such as operations, capital expenditure, tax, or treasury.

lpp.budget_code.description.name: description
lpp.budget_code.description.description: Human-readable label explaining the purpose of the budget code, such as 'Operating budget' or 'Capital expenditure'.

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier for each capital allocation actual record.

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.company_re.name: company_ref
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.company_re.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group for which capital allocation is recorded (e.g., GR_HOLDINGS, GR_US_INC, GR_EU_BV).

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.period_dat.name: period_date
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.period_dat.description: The quarter-end date representing the reporting period for the capital allocation actual figures.

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.bucket.name: bucket
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.bucket.description: Category of capital allocation use, such as capital expenditure, mergers and acquisitions, dividends, debt repayment, or share buybacks.

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.amount.name: amount
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.amount.description: Actual monetary amount allocated to the given capital bucket for the reporting period, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.currency_c.name: currency_code
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.currency_c.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the capital allocation amount is denominated (e.g., GBP, USD, EUR).

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.framework_.name: framework_target_pct
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.framework_.description: The capital allocation framework's target percentage share assigned to this bucket, representing the intended proportion of total capital to be deployed (e.g., 0.20 = 20%).

lpp.card_authorization.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_authorization.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each card authorization record.

lpp.card_authorization.pos_transaction_r.name: pos_transaction_ref
lpp.card_authorization.pos_transaction_r.description: Unique reference identifier assigned by the point-of-sale system to the originating transaction.

lpp.card_authorization.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.card_authorization.acquirer_ref.description: Code identifying the acquiring bank or payment processor that handled the authorization request, such as STRIPE, ADYEN, or FISERV.
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.card_authorization.network_code.name: network_code
lpp.card_authorization.network_code.description: Card payment network over which the authorization was processed, such as VISA, MASTERCARD, or AMEX.

lpp.card_authorization.bin_first6.name: bin_first6
lpp.card_authorization.bin_first6.description: First six digits of the card number representing the Bank Identification Number (BIN), used to identify the card issuer and product.

lpp.card_authorization.auth_request_ts.name: auth_request_ts
lpp.card_authorization.auth_request_ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the authorization request was sent to the acquirer or network.

lpp.card_authorization.auth_response_ts.name: auth_response_ts
lpp.card_authorization.auth_response_ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the authorization response was received from the acquirer or network.

lpp.card_authorization.response_time_ms.name: response_time_ms
lpp.card_authorization.response_time_ms.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds between the authorization request being sent and the response being received.

lpp.card_authorization.decision.name: decision
lpp.card_authorization.decision.description: Outcome of the authorization request, indicating whether the transaction was approved, declined, errored, or timed out.

lpp.card_authorization.decline_reason_co.name: decline_reason_code
lpp.card_authorization.decline_reason_co.description: Issuer-returned reason code explaining why an authorization was declined, using standard card network decline codes (e.g., 51 for insufficient funds, 14 for invalid card number).

lpp.card_authorization.amount.name: amount
lpp.card_authorization.amount.description: Monetary value of the transaction submitted for authorization, expressed in the transaction currency.

lpp.card_authorization.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.card_authorization.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the transaction amount, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.

lpp.card_authorization.transaction_size_.name: transaction_size_band
lpp.card_authorization.transaction_size_.description: Categorical band grouping the transaction amount into predefined ranges such as less than $25, $25–$100, $100–$500, $500–$5000, or greater than $5000.

lpp.card_authorization.region.name: region
lpp.card_authorization.region.description: Geographic region where the transaction originated, such as Americas, EMEA, Asia-Pacific, or Latin America.

lpp.card_authorization.auth_3ds_status.name: auth_3ds_status
lpp.card_authorization.auth_3ds_status.description: Outcome of the 3D Secure authentication step during the authorization flow, indicating whether the cardholder was challenged, passed frictionlessly, failed, or 3DS was not attempted.

lpp.card_authorization.device_fingerprin.name: device_fingerprint
lpp.card_authorization.device_fingerprin.description: Unique identifier representing the device used to initiate the transaction, generated from device attributes for fraud detection purposes.

lpp.card_authorization.cnp_indicator.name: cnp_indicator
lpp.card_authorization.cnp_indicator.description: Flag indicating whether the transaction was card-not-present (true) as opposed to a physical card-present transaction (false).

lpp.card_bin_range.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_bin_range.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each card BIN range record.

lpp.card_bin_range.bin_low.name: bin_low
lpp.card_bin_range.bin_low.description: The lowest 6-digit Bank Identification Number in a BIN range, representing the starting prefix of card numbers assigned to an issuer.

lpp.card_bin_range.bin_high.name: bin_high
lpp.card_bin_range.bin_high.description: The highest 6-digit Bank Identification Number in a BIN range, representing the ending prefix of card numbers assigned to an issuer.

lpp.card_bin_range.network_code.name: network_code
lpp.card_bin_range.network_code.description: The payment card network or scheme associated with the BIN range, such as Visa, Mastercard, or Amex.

lpp.card_bin_range.issuer_name.name: issuer_name
lpp.card_bin_range.issuer_name.description: The name of the financial institution that issued the card associated with the BIN range, such as Chase Issuer or RBC Debit.

lpp.card_bin_range.issuer_country.name: issuer_country
lpp.card_bin_range.issuer_country.description: The ISO 2-letter country code of the country where the card-issuing institution is based, such as US, GB, or JP.

lpp.card_bin_range.card_product.name: card_product
lpp.card_bin_range.card_product.description: The type of card product associated with the BIN range, indicating whether the card is a consumer credit, debit, commercial, charge, private label, or purchasing card.

lpp.card_network.code.name: code
lpp.card_network.code.description: Unique short-code identifier for a card network, such as VISA, MASTERCARD, or UNIONPAY.

lpp.card_network.name.name: name
lpp.card_network.name.description: Human-readable display name of the card network, such as American Express or Costco Private Label.

lpp.card_network.network_type.name: network_type
lpp.card_network.network_type.description: Category of the card network indicating whether it operates as a credit, debit PIN, charge, or private label payment scheme.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_rebate_earning.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each card rebate earning record.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.program_ref.name: program_ref
lpp.card_rebate_earning.program_ref.description: Code identifying the card rebate program associated with a specific banking partner and card type (e.g., JPMorgan Visa, BNP Purchasing Card, Amex Business, Citi Commercial).

lpp.card_rebate_earning.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.card_rebate_earning.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group for which the rebate earning is recorded.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.card_rebate_earning.period_date.description: Quarter-end date representing the reporting period for which the rebate earning is calculated.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.spend_category.name: spend_category
lpp.card_rebate_earning.spend_category.description: Classification of the type of business expenditure that generated eligible card spend for rebate purposes (e.g., Travel, Logistics, Utilities).

lpp.card_rebate_earning.eligible_spend.name: eligible_spend
lpp.card_rebate_earning.eligible_spend.description: Total monetary amount of card spend that qualifies for rebate calculation within the reporting period.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.rebate_earned.name: rebate_earned
lpp.card_rebate_earning.rebate_earned.description: Monetary amount of rebate earned from the card program based on eligible spend for the reporting period.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.card_rebate_earning.currency_code.description: ISO currency code denoting the currency in which the eligible spend and rebate amounts are denominated.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.tier_achieved.name: tier_achieved
lpp.card_rebate_earning.tier_achieved.description: Rebate tier level attained during the period based on spend volume, determining the applicable rebate rate (Base, Tier 1, or Tier 2).

lpp.card_rebate_program.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_rebate_program.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each card rebate program record.

lpp.card_rebate_program.code.name: code
lpp.card_rebate_program.code.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying a card rebate program, typically encoding the issuing bank and card type (e.g., REB_JPM_VCARD for JPMorgan Virtual Card).
value_aliases: REB_AMEX_BUS -> American Express Business Card Rebate
REB_BNP_PCARD -> BNP Paribas Purchasing Card Rebate

lpp.card_rebate_program.issuer_bank_ref.name: issuer_bank_ref
lpp.card_rebate_program.issuer_bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the bank that issues the card associated with the rebate program (e.g., BANK_JPM for JPMorgan, BANK_BNP for BNP Paribas).

lpp.card_rebate_program.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.card_rebate_program.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the corporate entity or legal entity enrolled in the card rebate program (e.g., GR_HOLDINGS, GR_US_INC).

lpp.card_rebate_program.program_type.name: program_type
lpp.card_rebate_program.program_type.description: Classification of the card rebate program by the type of corporate card used, such as purchasing card, virtual card, or commercial card.

lpp.card_rebate_program.rebate_tier_thre.name: rebate_tier_threshold
lpp.card_rebate_program.rebate_tier_thre.description: Minimum spend amount required for the company to qualify for the rebate tier and earn the associated rebate rate.

lpp.card_rebate_program.rebate_bps_at_ta.name: rebate_bps_at_target
lpp.card_rebate_program.rebate_bps_at_ta.description: Rebate rate expressed in basis points awarded to the company when the spend target threshold is met under the program.

lpp.card_rebate_program.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.card_rebate_program.effective_from.description: Calendar date from which the card rebate program terms become active and applicable.

lpp.card_rebate_program.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.card_rebate_program.effective_to.description: Calendar date on which the card rebate program terms expire and are no longer applicable.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_settlement_batch.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each card settlement batch record.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.card_settlement_batch.acquirer_ref.description: Code identifying the acquiring bank or payment processor responsible for settling the batch (e.g., FISERV, STRIPE, BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS).
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.card_settlement_batch.network_code.name: network_code
lpp.card_settlement_batch.network_code.description: Card network or payment scheme over which the transactions in the batch were processed (e.g., VISA, MASTERCARD, AMEX).

lpp.card_settlement_batch.settlement_cur.name: settlement_currency
lpp.card_settlement_batch.settlement_cur.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the batch was settled (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

lpp.card_settlement_batch.batch_close_ts.name: batch_close_ts
lpp.card_settlement_batch.batch_close_ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the settlement batch was officially closed by the merchant or point-of-sale system.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.processor_sett.name: processor_settle_ts
lpp.card_settlement_batch.processor_sett.description: Timestamp indicating when the acquiring processor completed settlement of the batch on their end.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.bank_deposit_t.name: bank_deposit_ts
lpp.card_settlement_batch.bank_deposit_t.description: Timestamp indicating when the net settlement funds were deposited into the merchant's bank account.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.bank_account_r.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.card_settlement_batch.bank_account_r.description: Reference code identifying the merchant bank account into which the settlement funds were deposited (e.g., USA_RGNL_OPERATING).
value_aliases: GR_US_INC_OP_4 -> GR US Inc Operating Account 4

lpp.card_settlement_batch.gross_sales_am.name: gross_sales_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.gross_sales_am.description: Total value of all sales transactions included in the settlement batch before any deductions.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.refund_amount.name: refund_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.refund_amount.description: Total monetary value of customer refunds or credits included in the settlement batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.chargeback_amo.name: chargeback_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.chargeback_amo.description: Total monetary value of chargebacks or disputed transactions deducted within the settlement batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.interchange_am.name: interchange_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.interchange_am.description: Total interchange fees charged by the card networks and paid to issuing banks within the settlement batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.network_assess.name: network_assessment_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.network_assess.description: Total fees assessed by the card network (e.g., Visa, Mastercard) on top of interchange for the batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.processor_marg.name: processor_margin_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.processor_marg.description: Fee amount retained by the acquiring processor as their margin or markup on the settlement batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.other_fees_amo.name: other_fees_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.other_fees_amo.description: Total of any additional miscellaneous fees deducted from the settlement batch not captured in other fee columns.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.net_settlement.name: net_settlement_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.net_settlement.description: Final amount deposited to the merchant after all deductions including refunds, chargebacks, interchange, and fees have been applied to gross sales.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.transaction_co.name: transaction_count
lpp.card_settlement_batch.transaction_co.description: Number of individual card transactions included in the settlement batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.sla_met.name: sla_met
lpp.card_settlement_batch.sla_met.description: Flag indicating whether the settlement batch was processed within the agreed service level agreement timeframe.

lpp.card_settlement_line.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_settlement_line.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each card settlement line record.

lpp.card_settlement_line.batch_ref.name: batch_ref
lpp.card_settlement_line.batch_ref.description: Reference identifier grouping multiple settlement line items into a single processing batch.

lpp.card_settlement_line.authorization_r.name: authorization_ref
lpp.card_settlement_line.authorization_r.description: Reference identifier linking a settlement line to its originating card authorization event.

lpp.card_settlement_line.gross_amount.name: gross_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.gross_amount.description: Total transaction amount before any fees or deductions are applied at settlement.

lpp.card_settlement_line.interchange_amo.name: interchange_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.interchange_amo.description: Monetary amount charged as interchange fee by the card-issuing network for processing the transaction.

lpp.card_settlement_line.interchange_bps.name: interchange_bps
lpp.card_settlement_line.interchange_bps.description: Interchange fee expressed in basis points, representing the rate applied to the transaction amount.

lpp.card_settlement_line.network_assessm.name: network_assessment_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.network_assessm.description: Fee assessed by the card network (e.g. Visa, Mastercard) on top of interchange for each settled transaction.

lpp.card_settlement_line.processor_margi.name: processor_margin_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.processor_margi.description: Monetary amount representing the payment processor's margin or markup charged on the settlement line.

lpp.card_settlement_line.other_fees_amou.name: other_fees_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.other_fees_amou.description: Catch-all monetary amount for miscellaneous fees applied to the settlement line that are not categorized elsewhere.

lpp.card_settlement_line.net_amount.name: net_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.net_amount.description: Final settled amount after all fees (interchange, network assessment, processor margin, and other fees) have been deducted from the gross amount.

lpp.card_settlement_line.issuer_country.name: issuer_country
lpp.card_settlement_line.issuer_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code indicating the country where the card-issuing bank is based (e.g. US, DE, JP).

lpp.card_settlement_line.cross_border.name: cross_border
lpp.card_settlement_line.cross_border.description: Flag indicating whether the transaction was processed across national borders, meaning the merchant and card-issuing countries differ.

lpp.card_settlement_line.dcc_applied.name: dcc_applied
lpp.card_settlement_line.dcc_applied.description: Flag indicating whether Dynamic Currency Conversion was applied to the transaction, allowing the cardholder to pay in their home currency.

lpp.card_settlement_line.fx_rate_applied.name: fx_rate_applied
lpp.card_settlement_line.fx_rate_applied.description: Foreign exchange rate used to convert the transaction amount between currencies at the time of settlement.

lpp.cash_balance.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.cash_balance.account_ref.description: Unique code identifying a cash account, encoding region, country, and purpose (e.g., GR_HK_OP_2 for a Hong Kong operating account, IHB_EUR_CONCENTRATION for a euro concentration account).

lpp.cash_balance.balance_date.name: balance_date
lpp.cash_balance.balance_date.description: The calendar date for which the cash balance is reported.

lpp.cash_balance.date_basis.name: date_basis
lpp.cash_balance.date_basis.description: Indicates whether the balance is calculated using the transaction booking date or the value (settlement) date.

lpp.cash_balance.includes_actual.name: includes_actual
lpp.cash_balance.includes_actual.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes actual (posted) transactions.

lpp.cash_balance.includes_intraday.name: includes_intraday
lpp.cash_balance.includes_intraday.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes intraday (same-day, not yet settled) transactions.

lpp.cash_balance.includes_confirmed.name: includes_confirmed
lpp.cash_balance.includes_confirmed.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes confirmed (bank-acknowledged but not yet settled) transactions.

lpp.cash_balance.includes_estimated.name: includes_estimated
lpp.cash_balance.includes_estimated.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes estimated (forecast or projected) transactions.

lpp.cash_balance.amount.name: amount
lpp.cash_balance.amount.description: The monetary cash balance for the account on the given date, expressed in the account's native currency.

lpp.cash_balance.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.cash_balance.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the cash balance amount is denominated (e.g., EUR, USD, GBP).

lpp.cash_balance.cash_flow_status.name: cash_flow_status
lpp.cash_balance.cash_flow_status.description: Indicates whether the cash balance is based on confirmed transactions or estimated/forecasted cash flows.

lpp.cash_flow.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.cash_flow.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each cash flow record.

lpp.cash_flow.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.cash_flow.account_ref.description: Coded reference identifying the bank account involved in the cash flow, encoding entity, country, and account purpose (e.g., collection or operating).

lpp.cash_flow.flow_code_ref.name: flow_code_ref
lpp.cash_flow.flow_code_ref.description: Categorical code classifying the type of cash flow transaction, such as payroll disbursement, tax payment, card interchange, or intercompany funding.
value_aliases: RCPT_AR_SEPA -> Accounts Receivable Receipt via SEPA
RCPT_AR_WIRE -> Accounts Receivable Receipt via Wire
DISB_AP_WIRE -> Accounts Payable Disbursement via Wire
DISB_AP_SEPA -> Accounts Payable Disbursement via SEPA
RCPT_AR_ACH -> Accounts Receivable Receipt via ACH
DISB_AP_ACH -> Accounts Payable Disbursement via ACH
DISB_AP_RTP -> Accounts Payable Disbursement via RTP

lpp.cash_flow.budget_code_ref.name: budget_code_ref
lpp.cash_flow.budget_code_ref.description: Budget classification code grouping cash flows into high-level spend or treasury categories such as operations, treasury, tax, or capital expenditure.

lpp.cash_flow.status.name: status
lpp.cash_flow.status.description: Indicates whether the cash flow has been confirmed as settled or remains a forward-looking forecast.

lpp.cash_flow.transaction_date.name: transaction_date
lpp.cash_flow.transaction_date.description: The date on which the cash flow transaction was initiated or recorded.

lpp.cash_flow.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.cash_flow.value_date.description: The date on which the funds are considered available or settled in the account.

lpp.cash_flow.update_date_time.name: update_date_time
lpp.cash_flow.update_date_time.description: Timestamp recording when the cash flow record was last created or modified in the system.

lpp.cash_flow.flow_amount.name: flow_amount
lpp.cash_flow.flow_amount.description: The absolute monetary amount of the cash flow expressed in the transaction's original currency.

lpp.cash_flow.flow_currency.name: flow_currency
lpp.cash_flow.flow_currency.description: The ISO currency code in which the cash flow amount is denominated, such as USD, EUR, or JPY.

lpp.cash_flow.signed_amount.name: signed_amount
lpp.cash_flow.signed_amount.description: The cash flow amount with directional sign applied, where positive values represent inflows and negative values represent outflows.

lpp.cash_flow.account_amount.name: account_amount
lpp.cash_flow.account_amount.description: The cash flow amount converted into the denomination currency of the receiving or sending bank account.

lpp.cash_flow.account_currency.name: account_currency
lpp.cash_flow.account_currency.description: The ISO currency code of the bank account in which the cash flow is recorded, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.

lpp.cash_flow.fx_rate.name: fx_rate
lpp.cash_flow.fx_rate.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the flow currency into the account currency at the time of the transaction.

lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_name.name: counterparty_name
lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_name.description: The human-readable name of the external party involved in the cash flow, such as a vendor, payment service provider, or retail consumer.

lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_ref.name: counterparty_ref
lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_ref.description: Unique coded reference identifying the counterparty involved in the cash flow, used for systematic matching across transactions.

lpp.cash_flow.description.name: description
lpp.cash_flow.description.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature or purpose of the cash flow, such as payroll, rent, bank fees, or sweep instructions.

lpp.cash_flow.reference.name: reference
lpp.cash_flow.reference.description: Unique alphanumeric reference string, typically a UUID, used to identify or trace an individual cash flow transaction externally.

lpp.cash_flow.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.cash_flow.user_zones.description: Semi-structured data capturing the user-defined zones or access control tags associated with the cash flow record.

lpp.cash_flow.payment_rail.name: payment_rail
lpp.cash_flow.payment_rail.description: The payment network or clearing mechanism used to execute the cash flow, such as WIRE, ACH, SEPA, or RTP.

lpp.cash_flow_code.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.cash_flow_code.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each cash flow code record.

lpp.cash_flow_code.code.name: code
lpp.cash_flow_code.code.description: Short alphanumeric code that uniquely classifies a specific type of cash movement, such as a point-of-sale receipt, payroll disbursement, or intercompany funding.

lpp.cash_flow_code.description.name: description
lpp.cash_flow_code.description.description: Human-readable label explaining the business purpose of a cash flow code, such as 'Payroll', 'Tax payments', or 'Capital expenditure'.

lpp.cash_flow_code.sign.name: sign
lpp.cash_flow_code.sign.description: Indicates the direction of the cash flow, either money coming into the account (IN) or going out (OUT).

lpp.cash_flow_code.category.name: category
lpp.cash_flow_code.category.description: Classifies the cash flow code into a standard cash flow statement category: operating, investing, or financing activities.

lpp.chargeback.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.chargeback.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each chargeback record.

lpp.chargeback.authorization_ref.name: authorization_ref
lpp.chargeback.authorization_ref.description: UUID reference to the original payment authorization that is subject to the chargeback.

lpp.chargeback.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.chargeback.acquirer_ref.description: Code identifying the acquiring bank or payment processor that handled the original transaction (e.g., STRIPE, ADYEN, CHASE_PAYTECH).
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.chargeback.network_code.name: network_code
lpp.chargeback.network_code.description: The card network or payment scheme over which the chargeback was filed (e.g., VISA, MASTERCARD, AMEX).

lpp.chargeback.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.chargeback.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or regional subsidiary of the merchant against which the chargeback was raised (e.g., GR_US_INC, GR_GB).

lpp.chargeback.location_code.name: location_code
lpp.chargeback.location_code.description: Code identifying the warehouse or fulfilment location associated with the disputed transaction (e.g., WH_US_0004, WH_GB_0007).

lpp.chargeback.reason_code.name: reason_code
lpp.chargeback.reason_code.description: Card-network-specific numeric reason code assigned to the chargeback (e.g., Visa code 10.4 for fraud, Mastercard code 4855 for goods not received).
value_aliases: 10.4 -> Visa: Other Fraud – Card Absent Environment
13.3 -> Visa: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise/Services
4855 -> Mastercard: Goods or Services Not Provided

lpp.chargeback.reason_category.name: reason_category
lpp.chargeback.reason_category.description: High-level business category grouping the chargeback reason, such as FRAUD, NON_RECEIPT, or NOT_AS_DESCRIBED.
value_aliases: NON_RECEIPT -> Non-Receipt of Goods or Services

lpp.chargeback.initiated_date.name: initiated_date
lpp.chargeback.initiated_date.description: Calendar date on which the chargeback was formally initiated by the issuing bank.

lpp.chargeback.resolved_date.name: resolved_date
lpp.chargeback.resolved_date.description: Calendar date on which the chargeback case was closed or resolved.

lpp.chargeback.amount.name: amount
lpp.chargeback.amount.description: Monetary value of the chargeback disputed by the cardholder, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.chargeback.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.chargeback.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the chargeback amount is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

lpp.chargeback.status.name: status
lpp.chargeback.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the chargeback case, indicating whether it is open, contested, or concluded (e.g., WON, LOST, REPRESENTED, INITIATED).

lpp.chargeback.representment_attempted.name: representment_attempted
lpp.chargeback.representment_attempted.description: Flag indicating whether the merchant submitted a representment (dispute rebuttal) in response to the chargeback.

lpp.chargeback.representment_evidence_ur.name: representment_evidence_uri
lpp.chargeback.representment_evidence_ur.description: Storage URI pointing to the PDF document containing the evidence package submitted during chargeback representment (e.g., an S3 object path).

lpp.chargeback.classification.name: classification
lpp.chargeback.classification.description: Internal classification of the root cause of the chargeback, distinguishing between merchant error, true external fraud, and friendly fraud.

lpp.company.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.company.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each company record.

lpp.company.code.name: code
lpp.company.code.description: Short internal alphanumeric code uniquely identifying each legal entity within the corporate group, typically combining a group prefix with a country or entity abbreviation (e.g., GR_AU, GR_US_INC).

lpp.company.name.name: name
lpp.company.name.description: Full registered legal name of the company entity (e.g., GlobalRetail Australia Pty Ltd, GlobalRetail France SAS).

lpp.company.country.name: country
lpp.company.country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code indicating the country of incorporation or primary operation for the company (e.g., GB, AU, DE).

lpp.company.consolidation_code.name: consolidation_code
lpp.company.consolidation_code.description: Code used to group or map the company into the appropriate financial consolidation structure for reporting purposes.

lpp.company.corp_id_code.name: corp_id_code
