lpp.company.corp_id_code.description: Corporate identifier code assigned to the entity, typically used for internal or intercompany identification across systems.

lpp.company.lei.name: lei
lpp.company.lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) — a globally recognised 20-character alphanumeric code used to uniquely identify legal entities participating in financial transactions (e.g., LEI-GRAU, LEI-GRFR).

lpp.company.other_identifier_type.name: other_identifier_type
lpp.company.other_identifier_type.description: Numeric code indicating the type of an additional or alternative identifier held for the company beyond the primary LEI or corporate code.

lpp.company.other_identifier_value.name: other_identifier_value
lpp.company.other_identifier_value.description: The actual value of the alternative or supplementary identifier for the company, corresponding to the type specified in other_identifier_type.

lpp.company.sepa_creditor_identifier.name: sepa_creditor_identifier
lpp.company.sepa_creditor_identifier.description: SEPA Creditor Identifier (SCI) assigned to the company, used to uniquely identify the entity as a creditor in SEPA Direct Debit transactions.

lpp.company.txp.name: txp
lpp.company.txp.description: Tax payment reference or taxpayer identifier code associated with the company for tax remittance purposes.

lpp.company.tax_ids.name: tax_ids
lpp.company.tax_ids.description: Structured JSON object storing one or more tax identification numbers for the company across different jurisdictions.

lpp.company.address.name: address
lpp.company.address.description: Structured JSON object containing the registered or principal business address of the company.

lpp.company.contact.name: contact
lpp.company.contact.description: Structured JSON object holding contact information (such as phone, email, or contact person) for the company.

lpp.company.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.company.user_zones.description: Structured JSON object defining the access zones or organisational segments to which users associated with this company are assigned.

lpp.company_financial_metric.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.company_financial_metric.company_ref.description: Unique internal code identifying each legal entity within the group (e.g., GR_US_INC for the US incorporated entity, GR_APAC_PTE for the Asia-Pacific subsidiary).

lpp.company_financial_metric.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.company_financial_metric.period_date.description: The end date of the financial reporting period to which the metrics apply, using quarter-end or year-end dates (e.g., 2023-09-30 for Q3 2023).

lpp.company_financial_metric.period_type.name: period_type
lpp.company_financial_metric.period_type.description: Indicates whether the reported metrics cover a single quarter, a full fiscal year, or a trailing twelve-month window.

lpp.company_financial_metric.reporting_c.name: reporting_currency
lpp.company_financial_metric.reporting_c.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the financial metrics for this entity and period are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.company_financial_metric.revenue.name: revenue
lpp.company_financial_metric.revenue.description: Total net revenue (top-line sales) recognised by the entity for the reporting period, expressed in the reporting currency.

lpp.company_financial_metric.cogs.name: cogs
lpp.company_financial_metric.cogs.description: Cost of goods sold representing the direct costs attributable to producing the goods or services sold during the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.ebitda.name: ebitda
lpp.company_financial_metric.ebitda.description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortisation for the reporting period, a key measure of operating profitability.
synonyms: earnings before interest tax depreciation amortisation

lpp.company_financial_metric.operating_i.name: operating_income
lpp.company_financial_metric.operating_i.description: Profit from core business operations after deducting operating expenses including depreciation and amortisation but before interest and taxes.

lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_in.name: interest_income
lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_in.description: Income earned from interest-bearing assets such as cash deposits and short-term investments during the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_ex.name: interest_expense
lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_ex.description: Total interest cost incurred on borrowed funds and other financing obligations during the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.net_income.name: net_income
lpp.company_financial_metric.net_income.description: Bottom-line profit after all expenses, interest, taxes, and non-operating items have been deducted from revenue for the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.diluted_eps.name: diluted_eps
lpp.company_financial_metric.diluted_eps.description: Earnings per share calculated on a fully diluted basis, accounting for all potential shares from options, warrants, and convertible instruments.

lpp.company_financial_metric.cash_from_o.name: cash_from_operations
lpp.company_financial_metric.cash_from_o.description: Net cash generated from the entity's core operating activities during the reporting period, as reported in the cash flow statement.

lpp.company_financial_metric.capex.name: capex
lpp.company_financial_metric.capex.description: Capital expenditure representing cash spent on acquiring or upgrading physical and intangible long-term assets during the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.free_cash_f.name: free_cash_flow
lpp.company_financial_metric.free_cash_f.description: Cash available after capital expenditures have been deducted from operating cash flow, representing cash generated for debt service and distributions.

lpp.company_financial_metric.total_debt.name: total_debt
lpp.company_financial_metric.total_debt.description: Aggregate outstanding debt obligations of the entity including all short-term and long-term borrowings at the end of the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.short_term_.name: short_term_debt
lpp.company_financial_metric.short_term_.description: Debt obligations due within twelve months of the reporting period end date, including current portions of long-term debt.

lpp.company_financial_metric.long_term_d.name: long_term_debt
lpp.company_financial_metric.long_term_d.description: Debt obligations with a maturity of more than twelve months from the reporting period end date.

lpp.company_financial_metric.total_equit.name: total_equity
lpp.company_financial_metric.total_equit.description: Total shareholders' equity representing the residual interest in the entity's assets after deducting all liabilities at period end.

lpp.company_financial_metric.cash_and_eq.name: cash_and_equivalents
lpp.company_financial_metric.cash_and_eq.description: Highly liquid cash and near-cash assets held by the entity at the end of the reporting period, including bank balances and money market instruments.

lpp.company_financial_metric.short_term_.name: short_term_investments
lpp.company_financial_metric.short_term_.description: Financial investments with maturities typically under twelve months held by the entity as at the reporting period end date.

lpp.company_financial_metric.net_debt.name: net_debt
lpp.company_financial_metric.net_debt.description: Total debt less cash and cash equivalents, representing the entity's effective indebtedness position at the end of the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.debt_to_ebi.name: debt_to_ebitda
lpp.company_financial_metric.debt_to_ebi.description: Ratio of total debt to EBITDA indicating how many years of earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation would be required to repay outstanding debt.

lpp.company_financial_metric.leverage_ra.name: leverage_ratio
lpp.company_financial_metric.leverage_ra.description: A measure of financial leverage expressing the proportion of debt financing relative to equity or total capital employed by the entity.

lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_co.name: interest_coverage
lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_co.description: Ratio of operating earnings to interest expense indicating how many times the entity can cover its interest obligations from operating profit.

lpp.company_financial_metric.wacc_pct.name: wacc_pct
lpp.company_financial_metric.wacc_pct.description: Weighted average cost of capital expressed as a percentage, representing the blended required rate of return across all capital sources for the entity.

lpp.company_financial_metric.weighted_av.name: weighted_avg_cost_of_debt_pct
lpp.company_financial_metric.weighted_av.description: The blended average interest rate paid across all of the entity's outstanding debt obligations, expressed as a percentage.

lpp.company_financial_metric.return_on_c.name: return_on_capital_pct
lpp.company_financial_metric.return_on_c.description: Return on capital employed expressed as a percentage, measuring the profitability and efficiency with which the entity uses its total capital base.

lpp.company_financial_metric.diluted_sha.name: diluted_shares_outstanding
lpp.company_financial_metric.diluted_sha.description: Total number of shares used in diluted per-share calculations, including all potential shares from convertible securities, options, and warrants.

lpp.company_group.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.company_group.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each company group record.

lpp.company_group.code.name: code
lpp.company_group.code.description: Short alphanumeric code representing a defined company group such as a global consolidation group or a regional cluster (e.g., GROUP_AMER for Americas, GROUP_EMEA for Europe/Middle East/Africa).

lpp.company_group.description.name: description
lpp.company_group.description.description: Human-readable label explaining the scope or purpose of the company group, such as 'Americas' or 'Store-operating companies only'.

lpp.company_group_member.company_group_c.name: company_group_code
lpp.company_group_member.company_group_c.description: Identifies the regional or structural company group to which a member belongs, such as global, Americas, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, or Retail OpCo groupings.
value_aliases: GROUP_EMEA -> Europe, Middle East & Africa Group

lpp.company_group_member.company_code.name: company_code
lpp.company_group_member.company_code.description: Identifies the individual legal entity or operating company that is a member of a company group, typically representing a country-level or functional subsidiary.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.counterparty_exposure.as_of_date.description: The reporting date as of which the counterparty exposure snapshot was calculated.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.counterparty_b.name: counterparty_bank_ref
lpp.counterparty_exposure.counterparty_b.description: Internal reference code identifying the counterparty bank institution to which exposure is measured (e.g., BANK_JPM for JPMorgan, BANK_CITI for Citibank).

lpp.counterparty_exposure.deposits_amoun.name: deposits_amount
lpp.counterparty_exposure.deposits_amoun.description: The total value of cash deposits placed with the counterparty bank as of the reporting date, expressed in the reporting currency.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.investments_am.name: investments_amount
lpp.counterparty_exposure.investments_am.description: The total market or book value of investment securities held with or issued by the counterparty bank as of the reporting date.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.derivative_mtm.name: derivative_mtm_amount
lpp.counterparty_exposure.derivative_mtm.description: The mark-to-market value of derivative contracts outstanding with the counterparty bank as of the reporting date, representing positive replacement cost exposure.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.total_exposure.name: total_exposure
lpp.counterparty_exposure.total_exposure.description: The aggregate credit exposure to the counterparty bank across all instruments (deposits, investments, and derivatives) as of the reporting date.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.reporting_curr.name: reporting_currency
lpp.counterparty_exposure.reporting_curr.description: The currency in which all exposure amounts are denominated for this record, currently standardised to USD.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.pct_of_total.name: pct_of_total
lpp.counterparty_exposure.pct_of_total.description: The counterparty's total exposure expressed as a percentage of the overall portfolio counterparty exposure as of the reporting date.

lpp.credit_facility.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.credit_facility.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credit facility record.

lpp.credit_facility.code.name: code
lpp.credit_facility.code.description: Human-readable business code identifying a credit facility, encoding type, currency, and counterparty (e.g., CF_RCF_USD_2B for a USD 2-billion revolving credit facility).

lpp.credit_facility.facility_type.name: facility_type
lpp.credit_facility.facility_type.description: Classification of the credit facility by its structural type, such as revolving credit, term loan, overdraft, commercial paper, or intercompany lending.

lpp.credit_facility.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.credit_facility.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that is the borrower or owner of the credit facility.

lpp.credit_facility.lender_bank_ref.name: lender_bank_ref
lpp.credit_facility.lender_bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the bank or financial institution providing the credit facility.

lpp.credit_facility.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.credit_facility.currency_ref.description: ISO currency code denoting the denomination in which the credit facility is drawn and repaid.

lpp.credit_facility.commitment_amount.name: commitment_amount
lpp.credit_facility.commitment_amount.description: Total maximum amount the lender has committed to make available under the credit facility, expressed in the facility currency.

lpp.credit_facility.start_date.name: start_date
lpp.credit_facility.start_date.description: The date on which the credit facility became effective and available for drawing.

lpp.credit_facility.maturity_date.name: maturity_date
lpp.credit_facility.maturity_date.description: The date on which the credit facility expires and all outstanding amounts must be repaid.

lpp.credit_facility.benchmark_code.name: benchmark_code
lpp.credit_facility.benchmark_code.description: The interest rate benchmark index used to calculate the floating rate on the facility, such as SOFR, ESTR, or SONIA.

lpp.credit_facility.spread_bps.name: spread_bps
lpp.credit_facility.spread_bps.description: The credit margin added above the benchmark rate for the facility, expressed in basis points.

lpp.credit_facility.commitment_fee_bps.name: commitment_fee_bps
lpp.credit_facility.commitment_fee_bps.description: The annualised fee charged on the undrawn portion of the credit facility, expressed in basis points; applicable primarily to revolving and term facilities.

lpp.credit_facility.status.name: status
lpp.credit_facility.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit facility, indicating whether it is active and available for use.

lpp.credit_rating.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.credit_rating.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credit rating record.

lpp.credit_rating.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.credit_rating.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary to which the credit rating applies, such as the holding company or regional operating entities.

lpp.credit_rating.agency.name: agency
lpp.credit_rating.agency.description: The credit rating agency that issued the rating, such as Moody's, S&P, or Fitch.

lpp.credit_rating.rating_grade.name: rating_grade
lpp.credit_rating.rating_grade.description: The alphanumeric credit rating grade assigned by the agency, reflecting the assessed creditworthiness of the entity (e.g., A1, AA-, BBB+).

lpp.credit_rating.outlook.name: outlook
lpp.credit_rating.outlook.description: The agency's forward-looking assessment of the likely direction of the credit rating, such as Stable or Positive.

lpp.credit_rating.rating_action.name: rating_action
lpp.credit_rating.rating_action.description: The action taken by the rating agency at the time of the rating event, such as affirming or upgrading the existing rating.

lpp.credit_rating.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.credit_rating.as_of_date.description: The effective date on which the credit rating was assigned or last updated by the agency.

lpp.credit_rating.is_current.name: is_current
lpp.credit_rating.is_current.description: Flag indicating whether this rating record represents the most current active rating for the entity and agency combination.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each individual cross-border payment leg record.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.transfer_uu.name: transfer_uuid
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.transfer_uu.description: Unique identifier of the parent transfer that this payment leg belongs to.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.payment_tra.name: payment_transaction_uuid
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.payment_tra.description: Unique identifier linking this payment leg to an associated payment transaction.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.origination.name: origination_country
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.origination.description: ISO country code or regional code representing the country from which the payment originates (e.g., US, DE, AE).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.destination.name: destination_country
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.destination.description: ISO country code representing the country where the payment is being received (e.g., SG, IN, CA).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.send_curren.name: send_currency
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.send_curren.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the currency in which the sender initiates the payment (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.receive_cur.name: receive_currency
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.receive_cur.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the currency in which the recipient receives the payment (e.g., INR, SGD, CAD).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.corridor.name: corridor
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.corridor.description: Named payment corridor representing the origin-to-destination regional route for the cross-border payment (e.g., US-EU, EU-APAC).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.send_amount.name: send_amount
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.send_amount.description: The monetary amount sent by the originator in the send currency.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.receive_amo.name: receive_amount
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.receive_amo.description: The monetary amount received by the beneficiary in the receive currency after conversion.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.fx_rate_app.name: fx_rate_applied
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.fx_rate_app.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert the send currency to the receive currency for this payment leg.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.fx_spread_b.name: fx_spread_bps
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.fx_spread_b.description: The foreign exchange spread charged on this payment leg, expressed in basis points (e.g., 41 bps, 75 bps).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.lifting_fee.name: lifting_fees
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.lifting_fee.description: Fees charged by the initiating institution to process and lift the cross-border payment.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.corresponde.name: correspondent_fees
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.corresponde.description: Fees charged by correspondent or intermediary banks involved in routing the cross-border payment.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.payment_met.name: payment_method
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.payment_met.description: The payment rail or method used to execute the cross-border payment leg (e.g., WIRE, ACH, SEPA_CT, RTP).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.initiated_a.name: initiated_at
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.initiated_a.description: Timestamp indicating when the cross-border payment leg was initiated.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.delivered_a.name: delivered_at
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.delivered_a.description: Timestamp indicating when the cross-border payment leg was successfully delivered to the beneficiary.

lpp.currency.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.currency.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each currency record.

lpp.currency.code.name: code
lpp.currency.code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code identifying the currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.currency.description.name: description
lpp.currency.description.description: Full human-readable name of the currency (e.g., 'US Dollar', 'Euro', 'Pound Sterling').

lpp.currency.number_of_decimals.name: number_of_decimals
lpp.currency.number_of_decimals.description: The number of decimal places used when expressing monetary amounts in this currency.

lpp.currency.delivery_float.name: delivery_float
lpp.currency.delivery_float.description: The number of business days (float) allowed for settlement or delivery of transactions in this currency.

lpp.currency.is_reference.name: is_reference
lpp.currency.is_reference.description: Flag indicating whether this currency serves as the reference or base currency for exchange rate calculations.

lpp.currency.hide_in_list.name: hide_in_list
lpp.currency.hide_in_list.description: Flag indicating whether this currency should be hidden from user-facing currency selection lists or dropdowns.

lpp.data_permission.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.data_permission.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each data permission record.

lpp.data_permission.profile_code.name: profile_code
lpp.data_permission.profile_code.description: Coded identifier representing the access profile assigned to a permission, indicating the scope and level of data access (e.g., global full access, regional read-write, or functional operations).

lpp.data_permission.entity_type.name: entity_type
lpp.data_permission.entity_type.description: Classification of the business entity to which the data permission applies, such as a company or a bank account.

lpp.data_permission.entity_code.name: entity_code
lpp.data_permission.entity_code.description: Business code identifying the specific company or bank account entity to which the data permission is scoped, covering legal entities and accounts across various countries and regions.

lpp.data_permission_profile.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.data_permission_profile.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each data permission profile record.

lpp.data_permission_profile.code.name: code
lpp.data_permission_profile.code.description: Short machine-readable code representing a named data permission profile, such as global full access, regional read/write, or functional operations roles.

lpp.data_permission_profile.description.name: description
lpp.data_permission_profile.description.description: Human-readable explanation of the data permission profile's scope and access level, such as regional read/write or functional operations coverage.

lpp.derivative_mtm.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.derivative_mtm.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each mark-to-market record for deduplication and system tracking purposes.

lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_type.name: instrument_type
lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_type.description: Classification of the derivative instrument being valued, with all current records representing FX forward contracts.

lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_ref.description: Unique business reference code identifying a specific derivative instrument, such as an individual FX forward contract.

lpp.derivative_mtm.counterparty_bank_ref.name: counterparty_bank_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.counterparty_bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the external bank acting as the counterparty on the derivative contract.

lpp.derivative_mtm.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the internal group legal entity that holds the derivative instrument.

lpp.derivative_mtm.valuation_date.name: valuation_date
lpp.derivative_mtm.valuation_date.description: The date on which the derivative instrument was marked to market and the MTM value was calculated.

lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_amount.name: mtm_amount
lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_amount.description: The mark-to-market fair value of the derivative instrument expressed in the reporting currency as of the valuation date.

lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_currency.name: mtm_currency
lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_currency.description: The currency in which the mark-to-market amount is denominated, currently standardized to USD across all records.

lpp.equity_action.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.equity_action.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each equity action record.

lpp.equity_action.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.equity_action.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the company that performed the equity action (e.g., GR_HOLDINGS).

lpp.equity_action.action_type.name: action_type
lpp.equity_action.action_type.description: Category of equity action taken by the company, such as a share buyback, regular dividend, or special dividend.

lpp.equity_action.action_date.name: action_date
lpp.equity_action.action_date.description: The calendar date on which the equity action (e.g., dividend declaration or buyback execution) occurred.

lpp.equity_action.settle_date.name: settle_date
lpp.equity_action.settle_date.description: The date on which the equity action financially settles and funds or shares are transferred.

lpp.equity_action.shares.name: shares
lpp.equity_action.shares.description: Number of shares involved in the equity action, such as shares repurchased in a buyback or shares eligible for a dividend.

lpp.equity_action.price_per_share.name: price_per_share
lpp.equity_action.price_per_share.description: The monetary price paid per share in the equity action, typically applicable for buyback transactions.

lpp.equity_action.total_amount.name: total_amount
lpp.equity_action.total_amount.description: The total monetary value of the equity action, representing the aggregate cash outlay for buybacks or total dividend paid.

lpp.equity_action.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.equity_action.currency_code.description: ISO currency code in which the equity action amounts are denominated (e.g., USD).

lpp.equity_action.dividend_per_share.name: dividend_per_share
lpp.equity_action.dividend_per_share.description: The cash dividend amount distributed per share, applicable for regular or special dividend actions.

lpp.equity_action.program_name.name: program_name
lpp.equity_action.program_name.description: The name of the specific corporate program under which the equity action was executed, such as a named buyback or dividend program.
value_aliases: GR_HOLDINGS_QUARTERLY_DIVIDEND -> GR Holdings Quarterly Dividend Program

lpp.equity_action.authorization_remainin.name: authorization_remaining
lpp.equity_action.authorization_remainin.description: The remaining monetary amount authorized but not yet utilized under the equity action program, typically applicable to share buyback authorizations.

lpp.fee_rate_card.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fee_rate_card.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each fee rate card record.

lpp.fee_rate_card.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.fee_rate_card.bank_ref.description: Coded reference identifying the bank or financial institution to which the fee rate applies (e.g., BANK_ANZ for ANZ, BANK_JPM for JPMorgan).

lpp.fee_rate_card.service_code.name: service_code
lpp.fee_rate_card.service_code.description: Standardised code identifying the type of banking service or product to which the negotiated fee rate applies.

lpp.fee_rate_card.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fee_rate_card.company_ref.description: Reference identifying the internal company or legal entity for which the fee rate card is applicable.

lpp.fee_rate_card.negotiated_rate.name: negotiated_rate
lpp.fee_rate_card.negotiated_rate.description: The contractually agreed fee rate charged by the bank for the given service, expressed in the unit defined by rate_unit.

lpp.fee_rate_card.rate_unit.name: rate_unit
lpp.fee_rate_card.rate_unit.description: Indicates the basis on which the negotiated rate is charged, such as per transaction, per month, or per USD 1,000 of value.

lpp.fee_rate_card.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.fee_rate_card.currency_code.description: ISO currency code in which the negotiated fee rate is denominated (currently USD only).

lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_from.description: The calendar date from which the negotiated fee rate becomes valid and applicable.

lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_to.description: The calendar date on which the negotiated fee rate expires; a null value indicates the rate is currently active with no defined end date.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each forecast cash flow record.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.snapshot_id.description: Identifier for the forecast snapshot version, encoding the snapshot date and frequency (monthly 'M' or quarterly 'Q') at which the forecast was captured, e.g. FC_20240101_M.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary for which the cash flow is forecast, such as a country-specific operating company or treasury entity.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the bank or financial account associated with the forecast cash flow.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_date.name: forecast_date
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_date.description: The calendar date (month start) for which the cash flow amount is forecast, representing the expected period of occurrence.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_category.name: flow_category
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_category.description: High-level business classification of the cash flow type, such as accounts receivable collections, accounts payable disbursements, payroll, tax, capital expenditure, debt service, or intercompany flows.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_subcategory.name: flow_subcategory
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_subcategory.description: Finer-grained classification of the cash flow within its parent category, providing additional detail about the nature of the flow.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.direction.name: direction
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.direction.description: Indicates whether the forecast cash flow is an inflow, outflow, or both (net) for the entity.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_amount.name: forecast_amount
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_amount.description: The projected monetary value of the cash flow for the forecast period, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code denoting the currency in which the forecast cash flow amount is expressed.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.confidence.name: confidence
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.confidence.description: Qualitative rating indicating the forecaster's level of certainty in the projected cash flow amount, ranging from low to high.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.seasonality_facto.name: seasonality_factor
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.seasonality_facto.description: Multiplicative adjustment factor applied to account for seasonal variation in cash flows, where 1.0 represents no seasonal adjustment, values below 1.0 indicate seasonal suppression, and values above 1.0 indicate seasonal uplift.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_id.description: Unique identifier for a forecast snapshot, encoded as a combination of a prefix, the snapshot date (YYYYMMDD), and the frequency suffix (M for monthly, Q for quarterly), e.g. 'FC_20250801_M'.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_date.name: snapshot_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_date.description: The calendar date on which the forecast snapshot was taken or published.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_start_date.name: horizon_start_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_start_date.description: The first calendar date of the forecast horizon covered by this snapshot.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_end_date.name: horizon_end_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_end_date.description: The last calendar date of the forecast horizon covered by this snapshot.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.granularity.name: granularity
lpp.forecast_snapshot.granularity.description: The time granularity at which forecast data points are expressed within this snapshot, either daily or monthly.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.model_version.name: model_version
lpp.forecast_snapshot.model_version.description: The version identifier of the forecasting model used to generate this snapshot, e.g. 'v1.3'.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.description.name: description
lpp.forecast_snapshot.description.description: A human-readable label describing the forecast methodology and horizon of the snapshot, such as 'Monthly 13-week direct forecast' or 'Quarterly 18-month indirect forecast'.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.company_ref.description: Short code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group (e.g., GR_ES for the Spanish entity, GR_DE for Germany).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.period_date.description: The last calendar day of the reporting month for which forecast and actual cash flow amounts are compared.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.flow_category.name: flow_category
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.flow_category.description: The type of cash flow activity being tracked, such as capital expenditure, accounts receivable collections, accounts payable disbursements, FX revaluation, payroll, or tax payments.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.forecast_amount.name: forecast_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.forecast_amount.description: The projected cash flow amount in USD for the entity, period, and flow category as captured at the time of the forecast snapshot.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.actual_amount.name: actual_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.actual_amount.description: The realized cash flow amount in USD for the entity, period, and flow category as recorded after the period closed.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_amount.name: variance_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_amount.description: The absolute difference in USD between the actual and forecast cash flow amounts, indicating over- or under-performance against the plan.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_pct.name: variance_pct
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_pct.description: The percentage deviation of the actual cash flow from the forecast amount, ranging from approximately -24% to +19% in observed data.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.snapshot_id.description: A unique identifier for the forecast run, encoding the date and frequency of the forecast cycle (e.g., FC_20230501_M indicates a monthly forecast produced on 2023-05-01).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in this table are denominated, consistently USD across all records.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each fraud detection event record.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.transfer_uuid.name: transfer_uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.transfer_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the payment transfer associated with this fraud detection event, when applicable.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.file_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the file associated with this fraud detection event, when applicable.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.decision.name: decision
lpp.fraud_detection_event.decision.description: The outcome of the fraud assessment, indicating whether the transaction was allowed, flagged for manual review, or blocked.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.score.name: score
lpp.fraud_detection_event.score.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned to the event, where higher values indicate greater likelihood of fraudulent activity.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.reason_codes.name: reason_codes
lpp.fraud_detection_event.reason_codes.description: Structured list of codes explaining the factors that contributed to the fraud detection decision.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.raised_at.name: raised_at
lpp.fraud_detection_event.raised_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the fraud detection event was triggered.

lpp.fraud_loss.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fraud_loss.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each fraud loss record.

lpp.fraud_loss.detection_event_uuid.name: detection_event_uuid
lpp.fraud_loss.detection_event_uuid.description: Unique identifier referencing the fraud detection event that triggered this loss record.

lpp.fraud_loss.authorization_ref.name: authorization_ref
lpp.fraud_loss.authorization_ref.description: Unique reference identifier for the payment authorization associated with the fraudulent transaction.

lpp.fraud_loss.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fraud_loss.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or country-specific subsidiary where the fraud loss was incurred, such as GR_US_INC or GR_FR.

lpp.fraud_loss.channel.name: channel
lpp.fraud_loss.channel.description: Sales or transaction channel through which the fraudulent activity occurred, such as in-warehouse, e-commerce, or membership renewal.

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_date.name: loss_date
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_date.description: Calendar date on which the fraud loss was recognized or incurred.

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_amount.name: loss_amount
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_amount.description: Monetary value of the fraud loss incurred, expressed in the transaction currency.

lpp.fraud_loss.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.fraud_loss.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code denoting the currency in which the loss and recovered amounts are denominated.

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_category.name: loss_category
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_category.description: Classification of the fraud loss type, distinguishing between first-party friendly fraud and third-party true fraud.

lpp.fraud_loss.fraud_vector.name: fraud_vector
lpp.fraud_loss.fraud_vector.description: Method or attack vector used to commit the fraud, such as card-not-present or social engineering.

lpp.fraud_loss.issuer_country.name: issuer_country
lpp.fraud_loss.issuer_country.description: Country code of the card-issuing bank associated with the fraudulent transaction.

lpp.fraud_loss.auth_method.name: auth_method
lpp.fraud_loss.auth_method.description: Authentication method used at the time of the transaction, indicating whether 3D Secure challenge, frictionless flow, no 3DS, or no authentication was applied.

lpp.fraud_loss.recovered_amount.name: recovered_amount
lpp.fraud_loss.recovered_amount.description: Monetary amount recovered from the fraud loss through chargebacks, disputes, or other recovery processes.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each FX exposure forecast record.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group that holds the FX exposure.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.forecast_period.name: forecast_period
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.forecast_period.description: Month-end date representing the future period for which the FX exposure is being forecast.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.tenor_bucket.name: tenor_bucket
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.tenor_bucket.description: Time-horizon bucket classifying the forecast exposure by its maturity range (e.g., within 1 month, 1–3 months, or 3–6 months).

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.exposure_curren.name: exposure_currency
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.exposure_curren.description: ISO currency code of the foreign currency in which the exposure is denominated.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.functional_curr.name: functional_currency
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.functional_curr.description: ISO currency code of the reporting entity's functional (home) currency against which the FX exposure is measured.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.gross_exposure_.name: gross_exposure_amount
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.gross_exposure_.description: Total gross monetary value of the forecasted FX exposure in the exposure currency before any netting or hedging.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.direction.name: direction
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.direction.description: Indicates whether the exposure represents a long (receivable/asset) or short (payable/liability) position in the foreign currency.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.source.name: source
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.source.description: Business origin or category of the FX exposure, such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, intercompany loans, or forecasted commercial cash flows.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.snapshot_date.name: snapshot_date
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.snapshot_date.description: Month-end date on which the FX exposure forecast data was captured or refreshed, used to track forecast vintages over time.

lpp.fx_forward.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fx_forward.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each FX forward contract record.

lpp.fx_forward.deal_id.name: deal_id
lpp.fx_forward.deal_id.description: Human-readable business identifier assigned to each FX forward deal, formatted as FXF-XXXXXXX.

lpp.fx_forward.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fx_forward.company_ref.description: Code identifying the internal legal entity or subsidiary of the group that entered into the FX forward contract.

lpp.fx_forward.counterparty_bank_ref.name: counterparty_bank_ref
lpp.fx_forward.counterparty_bank_ref.description: Code identifying the external bank counterparty with whom the FX forward contract was executed.

lpp.fx_forward.trade_date.name: trade_date
lpp.fx_forward.trade_date.description: The date on which the FX forward contract was agreed and executed.

lpp.fx_forward.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.fx_forward.value_date.description: The future settlement date on which the currency exchange under the FX forward contract is due to occur.

lpp.fx_forward.buy_currency.name: buy_currency
lpp.fx_forward.buy_currency.description: The ISO currency code of the currency that the company is purchasing under the FX forward contract.

lpp.fx_forward.buy_amount.name: buy_amount
lpp.fx_forward.buy_amount.description: The notional amount of the buy currency to be received by the company at settlement of the FX forward.

lpp.fx_forward.sell_currency.name: sell_currency
lpp.fx_forward.sell_currency.description: The ISO currency code of the currency the company is selling under the FX forward, consistently USD across all records.

lpp.fx_forward.sell_amount.name: sell_amount
lpp.fx_forward.sell_amount.description: The notional amount of the sell currency to be paid by the company at settlement of the FX forward.

lpp.fx_forward.forward_rate.name: forward_rate
lpp.fx_forward.forward_rate.description: The contracted exchange rate agreed at inception for the future delivery of the buy currency against the sell currency.

lpp.fx_forward.spot_at_trade.name: spot_at_trade
lpp.fx_forward.spot_at_trade.description: The prevailing spot exchange rate of the currency pair at the time the FX forward was traded.

lpp.fx_forward.status.name: status
lpp.fx_forward.status.description: The current lifecycle status of the FX forward contract, indicating whether it is active, settled, or cancelled.

lpp.fx_rate.rate_date.name: rate_date
lpp.fx_rate.rate_date.description: The calendar date for which the foreign exchange rate is valid or effective.

lpp.fx_rate.base_currency.name: base_currency
lpp.fx_rate.base_currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the base (from) currency in the exchange rate pair, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.

lpp.fx_rate.quote_currency.name: quote_currency
lpp.fx_rate.quote_currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the quote (to) currency in the exchange rate pair, such as EUR, GBP, or JPY.

lpp.fx_rate.rate.name: rate
lpp.fx_rate.rate.description: The numeric exchange rate representing how many units of the quote currency equal one unit of the base currency.

lpp.fx_rate.rate_type.name: rate_type
lpp.fx_rate.rate_type.description: The type of exchange rate recorded, indicating whether it is a spot, daily closing, or average rate.

lpp.fx_rate.source.name: source
lpp.fx_rate.source.description: The data provider or origin of the exchange rate, such as Bloomberg, the European Central Bank, or an internal system.

lpp.fx_rate.as_of_timestamp.name: as_of_timestamp
lpp.fx_rate.as_of_timestamp.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which the exchange rate record was last updated or loaded into the system.

lpp.gen_company_region.company_code.name: company_code
lpp.gen_company_region.company_code.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying a legal entity within the group, typically combining a 'GR_' prefix with a country or regional abbreviation (e.g., GR_DE for Germany, GR_APAC_PTE for the Asia-Pacific holding entity).

lpp.gen_company_region.region.name: region
lpp.gen_company_region.region.description: High-level geographic region to which the company entity belongs, such as EMEA, APAC, LATAM, AMER, or MENA.

lpp.gen_company_region.functional_ccy.name: functional_ccy
lpp.gen_company_region.functional_ccy.description: ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional (local reporting) currency of the company entity, such as EUR for a European entity or BRL for a Brazilian entity.

lpp.gl_account.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.gl_account.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each general ledger account record.

lpp.gl_account.code.name: code
lpp.gl_account.code.description: Structured account code combining a numeric GL account number with a company and bank account type identifier (e.g., '1110-GR_AE_COLLECTION_1').

lpp.gl_account.description.name: description
lpp.gl_account.description.description: Human-readable label for the GL account, such as 'Cash - GR_AU OPERATING Account', 'Revenue', or 'Accounts Payable'.

lpp.gl_account.chart_of_accounts.name: chart_of_accounts
lpp.gl_account.chart_of_accounts.description: The ERP system or chart of accounts framework under which the GL account is defined, such as SAP, NetSuite, or Oracle.

lpp.gl_account.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.gl_account.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that owns the GL account, such as GR_AE (UAE entity) or GR_AU (Australia entity).

lpp.gl_account.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.gl_account.bank_account_ref.description: Reference code linking the GL account to a specific physical bank account (e.g., GR_AU_PAYROLL_1); null for non-cash GL accounts.

lpp.gl_account.account_class.name: account_class
lpp.gl_account.account_class.description: High-level classification of the GL account within the balance sheet or income statement, such as ASSET, LIABILITY, EQUITY, REVENUE, or EXPENSE.

lpp.gl_account.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.gl_account.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the GL account is denominated, such as USD, EUR, or AUD.

lpp.gl_balance.gl_account_ref.name: gl_account_ref
lpp.gl_balance.gl_account_ref.description: Unique composite reference identifying a general ledger account combined with an entity or region code (e.g., '2200-GR_KR', '1110-IHB_CHF_INVESTMENT'), serving as the primary key for a balance record.

lpp.gl_balance.balance_date.name: balance_date
lpp.gl_balance.balance_date.description: The month-end date as of which the general ledger balance is reported, always falling on the last day of the month.

lpp.gl_balance.balance_type.name: balance_type
lpp.gl_balance.balance_type.description: Indicates the type of balance snapshot recorded; currently only 'CLOSING' balances are stored, representing end-of-period closing figures.

lpp.gl_balance.amount.name: amount
lpp.gl_balance.amount.description: The monetary value of the general ledger account balance as of the reporting date, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.gl_balance.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.gl_balance.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the balance amount is denominated (e.g., EUR, USD, GBP).

lpp.gl_balance.source_system.name: source_system
lpp.gl_balance.source_system.description: The name of the ERP or accounting system from which the GL balance data was extracted (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Oracle).

lpp.gl_balance.loaded_at.name: loaded_at
lpp.gl_balance.loaded_at.description: The timestamp indicating when the GL balance record was loaded into the data warehouse, aligned to month-end boundaries.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.gl_reconciliation.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each GL reconciliation record.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_account_ref.description: Coded reference label identifying the specific bank account being reconciled, encoding region, entity, currency, and account purpose (e.g., operating, payroll, tax, collection).

lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_account_ref.name: gl_account_ref
lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_account_ref.description: Coded reference label identifying the general ledger account corresponding to a bank account, typically prefixed with a GL account number followed by the account descriptor.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.gl_reconciliation.as_of_date.description: The month-end date as of which the bank-to-GL reconciliation snapshot was taken.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_balance.name: bank_balance
lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_balance.description: The closing balance reported by the bank for the account as of the reconciliation date, expressed in the account's native currency.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_balance.name: gl_balance
lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_balance.description: The closing balance recorded in the general ledger for the account as of the reconciliation date, expressed in the account's native currency.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_amount.name: variance_amount
lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_amount.description: The monetary difference between the bank balance and the GL balance at the reconciliation date, with zero indicating a fully matched reconciliation.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_currency.name: variance_currency
lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_currency.description: The ISO currency code in which the variance amount between the bank and GL balances is expressed.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.status.name: status
lpp.gl_reconciliation.status.description: The current reconciliation outcome indicating whether the bank and GL balances agree or are under active investigation.
value_aliases: MATCHED -> Balances reconciled with no outstanding variance
INVESTIGATING -> Variance identified and under active investigation

lpp.gl_reconciliation.notes.name: notes
lpp.gl_reconciliation.notes.description: Free-text annotations provided by reconciliation staff describing the nature of any variance, root cause findings, or resolution details.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each hedge de-designation record.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.hedge_ref.name: hedge_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.hedge_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the hedge relationship that is being de-designated (e.g., HR-0001532).

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or company within the group that owns the hedge being de-designated (e.g., GR_US_INC, GR_TREASURY).

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the notional amount associated with the de-designated hedge (e.g., AUD, SGD, BRL).

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.dedesignation_da.name: dedesignation_date
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.dedesignation_da.description: The calendar date on which the hedge relationship was formally de-designated.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.amount.name: amount
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.amount.description: The notional or financial amount associated with the de-designated portion of the hedge relationship.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.reason.name: reason
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.reason.description: Descriptive explanation for why the hedge was de-designated, such as restructuring or termination of the underlying instrument.

lpp.hedge_relationship.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.hedge_relationship.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each hedge relationship record.

lpp.hedge_relationship.code.name: code
lpp.hedge_relationship.code.description: Human-readable business code assigned to each hedge relationship, formatted as HR-XXXXXXX.

lpp.hedge_relationship.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.hedge_relationship.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group that owns the hedge relationship.

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedge_type.name: hedge_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedge_type.description: Classification of the hedge relationship according to accounting standards, indicating whether it is a cash flow, fair value, or net investment hedge.

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_item_type.name: hedged_item_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_item_type.description: Type of underlying exposure being hedged, such as a recognized receivable or payable, a forecasted transaction, or a net investment in a foreign operation.
value_aliases: NET_INVESTMENT -> Net Investment in Foreign Operation

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_currency.name: hedged_currency
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_currency.description: ISO currency code of the foreign currency exposure being hedged in the relationship.

lpp.hedge_relationship.designation_date.name: designation_date
lpp.hedge_relationship.designation_date.description: Date on which the hedge relationship was formally designated and hedge accounting commenced.

lpp.hedge_relationship.dedesignation_dat.name: dedesignation_date
lpp.hedge_relationship.dedesignation_dat.description: Date on which the hedge relationship was de-designated and hedge accounting was discontinued, if applicable.

lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_type.name: instrument_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_type.description: Type of financial instrument used as the hedging instrument, currently exclusively FX forward contracts.

lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the specific hedging instrument, formatted as FXF-XXXXXXX.

lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_amount.name: notional_amount
lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_amount.description: Notional principal amount of the hedging instrument representing the size of the hedged exposure.

lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_currency.name: notional_currency
lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_currency.description: ISO currency code in which the notional amount of the hedging instrument is denominated.

lpp.hedge_relationship.effectiveness_met.name: effectiveness_method
lpp.hedge_relationship.effectiveness_met.description: Methodology used to assess and measure hedge effectiveness, currently exclusively the dollar-offset method.

lpp.hedge_relationship.status.name: status
lpp.hedge_relationship.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the hedge relationship, indicating whether it is active, terminated, or de-designated.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.intercompany_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each intercompany transaction record.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.reference.name: reference
lpp.intercompany_transaction.reference.description: Human-readable business reference number assigned to each intercompany transaction, formatted as IC- followed by a zero-padded sequence number (e.g. IC-0006669).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.transaction.name: transaction_date
lpp.intercompany_transaction.transaction.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was booked or recorded.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.intercompany_transaction.value_date.description: The effective settlement date on which funds are considered available or the transaction takes financial effect.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.intercompany_transaction.amount.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.currency_co.name: currency_code
lpp.intercompany_transaction.currency_co.description: The ISO 4217 currency code denoting the currency in which the intercompany transaction amount is denominated (e.g. EUR, USD, JPY).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.purpose.name: purpose
lpp.intercompany_transaction.purpose.description: The business reason or category for the intercompany transaction, such as funding, loan, cash pooling, royalty, dividend, or service fee.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_comp.name: source_company_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_comp.description: The internal code identifying the group entity that is the originating or sending party of the intercompany transaction (e.g. GR_TREASURY).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_acco.name: source_account_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_acco.description: The internal code identifying the in-house bank concentration account belonging to the source company from which the transaction is sent (e.g. IHB_EUR_CONCENTRATION).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_cash.name: source_cash_flow_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_cash.description: The unique identifier of the cash flow record on the source side that corresponds to this intercompany transaction.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_comp.name: target_company_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_comp.description: The internal code identifying the group subsidiary or entity that is the receiving party of the intercompany transaction (e.g. GR_FR, GR_JP).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_acco.name: target_account_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_acco.description: The internal code identifying the collection account of the target company that receives the intercompany transaction funds (e.g. GR_FR_COLLECTION_1).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_cash.name: target_cash_flow_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_cash.description: The unique identifier of the cash flow record on the target side that corresponds to this intercompany transaction.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.status.name: status
lpp.intercompany_transaction.status.description: The current processing state of the intercompany transaction, indicating whether it has been initiated or fully settled.

lpp.interest_accrual.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.interest_accrual.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each interest accrual record.

lpp.interest_accrual.accrual_date.name: accrual_date
lpp.interest_accrual.accrual_date.description: The calendar date on which the interest accrual was recorded.

lpp.interest_accrual.source_type.name: source_type
lpp.interest_accrual.source_type.description: The type of financial instrument or obligation that generated the interest accrual, such as a borrowing, an investment position, or a credit facility fee.

lpp.interest_accrual.source_uuid.name: source_uuid
lpp.interest_accrual.source_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the specific financial instrument or agreement that originated the interest accrual.

lpp.interest_accrual.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.interest_accrual.company_ref.description: A short code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group for which the interest accrual applies.

lpp.interest_accrual.amount.name: amount
lpp.interest_accrual.amount.description: The monetary value of the interest accrual for the given period, expressed in the local currency of the record.

lpp.interest_accrual.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.interest_accrual.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the interest accrual amount is denominated.

lpp.interest_accrual.direction.name: direction
lpp.interest_accrual.direction.description: Indicates whether the interest accrual represents a cost to the company (expense) or earnings received (income).

lpp.investment_instrument.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_instrument.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each investment instrument record.

lpp.investment_instrument.code.name: code
lpp.investment_instrument.code.description: Human-readable business code uniquely identifying each investment instrument, following a structured naming convention such as INV_MMF_0014.

lpp.investment_instrument.instrument_typ.name: instrument_type
lpp.investment_instrument.instrument_typ.description: Category of the investment instrument, such as Money Market Fund, Time Deposit, Treasury, Certificate of Deposit, Commercial Paper, Repo, or Bond.

lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_name.name: issuer_name
lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_name.description: Name of the entity that issued the investment instrument, such as a bank, government, or asset manager (e.g., BlackRock MMF, US Treasury, Bundesrepublik Deutschland).

lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_bank_re.name: issuer_bank_ref
lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_bank_re.description: Reference code identifying the bank that issued the instrument, applicable primarily to bank-issued products such as time deposits and certificates of deposit; nullable for non-bank issuers.

lpp.investment_instrument.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.investment_instrument.currency_ref.description: ISO currency code denoting the denomination currency of the investment instrument, such as USD, EUR, GBP, or SGD.

lpp.investment_instrument.coupon_rate.name: coupon_rate
lpp.investment_instrument.coupon_rate.description: Annual interest rate paid by the instrument to its holder, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 4.10 represents 4.10%); null for instruments that do not pay a coupon.

lpp.investment_instrument.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.investment_instrument.issue_date.description: Calendar date on which the investment instrument was originally issued or created.

lpp.investment_instrument.maturity_date.name: maturity_date
lpp.investment_instrument.maturity_date.description: Calendar date on which the investment instrument is scheduled to mature and principal is repaid; null for open-ended instruments such as money market funds.

lpp.investment_instrument.rating.name: rating
lpp.investment_instrument.rating.description: Credit rating assigned to the investment instrument by a recognized rating agency, reflecting its creditworthiness (e.g., AAA, AA+, A-1+).

lpp.investment_position.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_position.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each investment position record.

lpp.investment_position.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.investment_position.instrument_ref.description: Reference code identifying the specific financial instrument (e.g., money market fund) held in the investment position.

lpp.investment_position.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.investment_position.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the company or treasury entity that owns the investment position, currently always the group treasury.

lpp.investment_position.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.investment_position.bank_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the investment bank account used to hold the position, segmented by currency (USD, EUR, GBP, SGD).

lpp.investment_position.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.investment_position.as_of_date.description: The valuation or reporting date for which the investment position snapshot is recorded.

lpp.investment_position.face_amount.name: face_amount
lpp.investment_position.face_amount.description: The nominal or par value of the investment instrument held in the position, expressed in the position currency.

lpp.investment_position.market_value.name: market_value
lpp.investment_position.market_value.description: The current fair market value of the investment position as of the reporting date, expressed in the position currency.

lpp.investment_position.book_value.name: book_value
lpp.investment_position.book_value.description: The carrying or cost value of the investment position as recorded in the accounting books, expressed in the position currency.

lpp.investment_position.accrued_interest.name: accrued_interest
lpp.investment_position.accrued_interest.description: The interest income earned on the investment position but not yet received as of the reporting date.

lpp.investment_position.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.investment_position.currency_code.description: The ISO currency code of the investment position, indicating the denomination currency (USD, EUR, GBP, or SGD).

lpp.investment_position.yield_to_maturit.name: yield_to_maturity
lpp.investment_position.yield_to_maturit.description: The annualized yield to maturity of the investment instrument as a percentage, representing the expected return if held until maturity; approximately half of records have no value.

lpp.investment_position.duration_days.name: duration_days
lpp.investment_position.duration_days.description: The interest rate sensitivity or time-weighted duration of the investment position expressed in days.

lpp.investment_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each investment transaction record.

lpp.investment_transaction.instrument_re.name: instrument_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.instrument_re.description: Reference code identifying the specific investment instrument (e.g. certificate of deposit, time deposit, money market fund, bond) involved in the transaction.

lpp.investment_transaction.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the company or treasury entity on whose behalf the investment transaction is recorded.

lpp.investment_transaction.bank_account_.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.bank_account_.description: Reference code identifying the investment bank account, segmented by currency, used to fund or receive proceeds from the transaction.

lpp.investment_transaction.transaction_t.name: transaction_type
lpp.investment_transaction.transaction_t.description: Categorizes the nature of the investment transaction, distinguishing between an initial purchase, a coupon interest payment, or an instrument maturity event.

lpp.investment_transaction.trade_date.name: trade_date
lpp.investment_transaction.trade_date.description: The date on which the investment transaction was executed or agreed upon.

lpp.investment_transaction.settle_date.name: settle_date
lpp.investment_transaction.settle_date.description: The date on which the investment transaction was financially settled and funds were exchanged.

lpp.investment_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.investment_transaction.amount.description: The monetary value of the investment transaction expressed in the transaction currency.

lpp.investment_transaction.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.investment_transaction.currency_code.description: The ISO currency code representing the denomination of the investment transaction (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, SGD).

lpp.investment_transaction.price.name: price
lpp.investment_transaction.price.description: The purchase or settlement price of the investment instrument per unit at the time of the transaction, expressed as a decimal close to par (e.g. 0.9943).

lpp.investment_transaction.yield_at_trad.name: yield_at_trade
lpp.investment_transaction.yield_at_trad.description: The annualized yield (in percentage terms) of the investment instrument at the time the transaction was executed, ranging from approximately 2.9% to 5.4%.

lpp.kg_relationship.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.kg_relationship.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each relationship record in the knowledge graph.

lpp.kg_relationship.relationship_type.name: relationship_type
lpp.kg_relationship.relationship_type.description: The nature or category of the relationship connecting two entities in the knowledge graph (e.g., 'owns', 'manages', 'belongs_to').

lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_type.name: from_entity_type
lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_type.description: The category or class of the source entity in the directed relationship (e.g., 'person', 'organization', 'product').

lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_code.name: from_entity_code
lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_code.description: The business code or identifier representing the specific source entity in the relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_type.name: to_entity_type
lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_type.description: The category or class of the target entity in the directed relationship (e.g., 'person', 'organization', 'product').

lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_code.name: to_entity_code
lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_code.description: The business code or identifier representing the specific target entity in the relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.properties.name: properties
lpp.kg_relationship.properties.description: A flexible semi-structured document storing additional attributes and metadata associated with the relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.captured_by_user.name: captured_by_user
lpp.kg_relationship.captured_by_user.description: The username or identifier of the user who recorded or created this relationship entry.

lpp.kg_relationship.captured_at.name: captured_at
lpp.kg_relationship.captured_at.description: The date and time (with timezone) at which this relationship was recorded in the system.

lpp.kg_relationship.source_session.name: source_session
lpp.kg_relationship.source_session.description: The identifier of the session or process during which this relationship was captured or imported.

lpp.kg_relationship.confidence.name: confidence
lpp.kg_relationship.confidence.description: A rating or level indicating how certain or reliable the identified relationship is considered to be.

lpp.kg_relationship.status.name: status
lpp.kg_relationship.status.description: The current lifecycle or workflow state of the relationship record (e.g., active, pending, archived).

lpp.letter_of_credit.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.letter_of_credit.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each letter of credit record.

lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_number.name: lc_number
lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_number.description: Human-readable reference number assigned to a letter of credit, formatted as LC-{year}-{sequence} (e.g., LC-2024-00020).

lpp.letter_of_credit.issuing_bank_ref.name: issuing_bank_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.issuing_bank_ref.description: Code identifying the bank that issued the letter of credit (e.g., BANK_HSBC, BANK_JPM).

lpp.letter_of_credit.applicant_company_r.name: applicant_company_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.applicant_company_r.description: Code identifying the group legal entity that applied for the letter of credit (e.g., GR_US_INC for the US subsidiary, GR_GB for the UK entity).

lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_name.name: beneficiary_name
lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_name.description: Full legal name of the party entitled to draw on the letter of credit, such as a supplier, utility provider, insurer, or government authority.

lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_country.name: beneficiary_country
lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_country.description: ISO 2-letter country code indicating the country where the beneficiary is located (e.g., US, GB, CN).

lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_type.name: lc_type
lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_type.description: Categorises the letter of credit as either a standby LC (used as a guarantee or last-resort payment) or a commercial LC (used to facilitate trade payments).

lpp.letter_of_credit.purpose.name: purpose
lpp.letter_of_credit.purpose.description: Business rationale or intended use for the letter of credit, such as apparel imports, utility deposit, customs duty deferment, or workers compensation insurance.

lpp.letter_of_credit.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.letter_of_credit.issue_date.description: Calendar date on which the letter of credit was formally issued by the issuing bank.

lpp.letter_of_credit.expiration_date.name: expiration_date
lpp.letter_of_credit.expiration_date.description: Calendar date after which the letter of credit is no longer valid for presentation or drawing.

lpp.letter_of_credit.face_amount.name: face_amount
lpp.letter_of_credit.face_amount.description: The total nominal value of the letter of credit as stated at issuance, denominated in the associated currency.

lpp.letter_of_credit.drawn_amount.name: drawn_amount
lpp.letter_of_credit.drawn_amount.description: The cumulative amount that has been drawn or called against the letter of credit by the beneficiary, denominated in the associated currency.

lpp.letter_of_credit.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.letter_of_credit.currency_code.description: ISO 3-letter currency code in which the letter of credit face and drawn amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

lpp.letter_of_credit.status.name: status
lpp.letter_of_credit.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the letter of credit, indicating whether it is active, has been drawn upon, or has passed its expiration date.

lpp.letter_of_credit.credit_facility_ref.name: credit_facility_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.credit_facility_ref.description: Code identifying the credit facility under which this letter of credit was issued (e.g., CF_RCF_USD_2B for a USD 2 billion revolving credit facility).

lpp.letter_of_credit.fee_bps.name: fee_bps
lpp.letter_of_credit.fee_bps.description: Annual fee charged by the issuing bank for the letter of credit, expressed in basis points of the face amount.

lpp.liquidity_policy.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.liquidity_policy.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each liquidity policy record.

lpp.liquidity_policy.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.liquidity_policy.company_ref.description: Reference to the specific legal entity or company to which the liquidity policy applies.

lpp.liquidity_policy.company_group_ref.name: company_group_ref
lpp.liquidity_policy.company_group_ref.description: The organizational group scope of the policy, such as global or a regional group (Americas, EMEA, APAC).

lpp.liquidity_policy.policy_type.name: policy_type
lpp.liquidity_policy.policy_type.description: The category of liquidity policy rule, such as minimum liquidity buffer, minimum operating cash, maximum counterparty concentration percentage, or maximum instrument tenor.

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_amount.name: threshold_amount
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_amount.description: The absolute monetary threshold value set by the policy, denominated in the associated threshold currency (null for percentage-based policies).

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_currency.name: threshold_currency
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_currency.description: The ISO currency code in which the threshold amount is expressed, such as USD or EUR.

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_pct.name: threshold_pct
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_pct.description: The percentage-based threshold set by the policy, used for concentration or ratio-type limits (null for amount-based policies).

lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_from.description: The date from which the liquidity policy rule becomes active and enforceable.

lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_to.description: The date on which the liquidity policy rule expires or is superseded; null indicates the policy is currently open-ended.

lpp.liquidity_policy.description.name: description
lpp.liquidity_policy.description.description: A human-readable label summarising the intent of the policy rule, such as regional cash floors, counterparty tier caps, or investment tenor limits.

lpp.macro_indicator.indicator_code.name: indicator_code
lpp.macro_indicator.indicator_code.description: Unique short code identifying the macroeconomic indicator being tracked, such as the Federal Funds Rate, 3-Month SOFR, Geopolitical Risk Index, US CPI, EUR/USD volatility, or Brent crude oil price.

lpp.macro_indicator.region.name: region
lpp.macro_indicator.region.description: Geographic scope of the macroeconomic indicator, distinguishing between US-specific and globally applicable measures.

lpp.macro_indicator.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.macro_indicator.as_of_date.description: The calendar date as of which the macroeconomic indicator value was recorded or published.

lpp.macro_indicator.value.name: value
lpp.macro_indicator.value.description: The numeric reading of the macroeconomic indicator as of the observation date, expressed in the unit specified for that indicator.

lpp.macro_indicator.unit.name: unit
lpp.macro_indicator.unit.description: The unit of measurement for the indicator value, such as percentage, index points, year-over-year percentage change, or US dollars per barrel.

lpp.macro_indicator.source.name: source
lpp.macro_indicator.source.description: The originating data provider or institution from which the macroeconomic indicator value was sourced, such as FRED, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, BLS, CME, or ICE.
value_aliases: FRED -> Federal Reserve Economic Data (St. Louis Fed)
FRBNY -> Federal Reserve Bank of New York
BBAEP -> British Bankers Association / Energy Pricing

lpp.mapping_entry.mapping_table_code.name: mapping_table_code
lpp.mapping_entry.mapping_table_code.description: Identifies the specific cross-reference mapping table being used, such as converting payment rails to AFP codes, flow types to GL accounts, bank identifiers to BIC codes, or company codes to functional currencies.
value_aliases: RAIL_TO_AFP -> Payment Rail to AFP Code
FLOW_TO_GL -> Cash Flow Type to GL Account
BANK_TO_BIC -> Bank Identifier to BIC/SWIFT Code

lpp.mapping_entry.source_value.name: source_value
lpp.mapping_entry.source_value.description: The input value in the mapping, representing the originating code or identifier to be translated, such as a payment rail type (WIRE, ACH, SEPA_CT), bank identifier, or cash flow category.

lpp.mapping_entry.target_value.name: target_value
lpp.mapping_entry.target_value.description: The output value produced by the mapping, representing the translated result such as a GL account number, BIC/SWIFT code, or ISO currency code corresponding to the source value.

lpp.mapping_table.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.mapping_table.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each mapping table record.

lpp.mapping_table.code.name: code
