lpp.mapping_table.code.description: Short machine-readable code identifying the type of business mapping being defined, such as payment rail to AFP service code or company to functional currency.
value_aliases: RAIL_TO_AFP -> Payment Rail to AFP Service Code
FLOW_TO_GL -> Cash Flow Code to GL Account Class
BANK_TO_BIC -> Internal Bank Code to BIC

lpp.mapping_table.description.name: description
lpp.mapping_table.description.description: Human-readable explanation of the mapping, describing the source concept and its target business entity (e.g., 'Payment rail → AFP service code').

lpp.mapping_table.scope.name: scope
lpp.mapping_table.scope.description: The applicability scope of the mapping, indicating whether it applies globally across all entities or is restricted to a specific region or entity.

lpp.membership_fee.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.membership_fee.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each membership fee record.

lpp.membership_fee.member_id.name: member_id
lpp.membership_fee.member_id.description: Unique identifier for the member associated with the fee, formatted as MBR- followed by a numeric code.

lpp.membership_fee.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.membership_fee.company_ref.description: Code identifying the regional or national company entity that collected the membership fee, such as GR_US_INC for the US entity or GR_GB for the UK entity.

lpp.membership_fee.channel.name: channel
lpp.membership_fee.channel.description: The sales or renewal channel through which the membership fee was collected, such as in-warehouse, e-commerce, auto-renewal, mail renewal, or new sign-up.

lpp.membership_fee.membership_tier.name: membership_tier
lpp.membership_fee.membership_tier.description: The tier level of the membership for which the fee was charged, such as Gold, Executive, or Business.

lpp.membership_fee.issued_date.name: issued_date
lpp.membership_fee.issued_date.description: The date on which the membership fee was issued or the membership period began.

lpp.membership_fee.expiration_date.name: expiration_date
lpp.membership_fee.expiration_date.description: The date on which the membership associated with this fee expires or is due for renewal.

lpp.membership_fee.fee_amount.name: fee_amount
lpp.membership_fee.fee_amount.description: The monetary amount charged for the membership fee, with observed values of 65, 120, or 130.

lpp.membership_fee.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.membership_fee.currency_code.description: The ISO currency code in which the membership fee amount is denominated, currently always USD.

lpp.membership_fee.payment_method.name: payment_method
lpp.membership_fee.payment_method.description: The method used by the member to pay the membership fee, currently always card-based payment.

lpp.membership_fee.status.name: status
lpp.membership_fee.status.description: The current collection status of the membership fee, indicating whether it was successfully collected, failed, charged back, or refunded.

lpp.membership_fee.fraud_loss.name: fraud_loss
lpp.membership_fee.fraud_loss.description: The monetary amount lost due to fraudulent activity on the membership fee transaction, equal to the fee amount when fraud is confirmed and zero otherwise.

lpp.payment_exception.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.payment_exception.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each payment exception record.

lpp.payment_exception.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.payment_exception.file_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the payment file associated with this exception.

lpp.payment_exception.transfer_uuid.name: transfer_uuid
lpp.payment_exception.transfer_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the payment transfer transaction linked to this exception.

lpp.payment_exception.exception_type.name: exception_type
lpp.payment_exception.exception_type.description: Category of the payment exception indicating the root cause, such as bank validation failure, file format error, beneficiary data issue, duplicate payment, OFAC compliance hold, or other.

lpp.payment_exception.detected_at.name: detected_at
lpp.payment_exception.detected_at.description: Timestamp when the payment exception was first detected by the system.

lpp.payment_exception.resolved_at.name: resolved_at
lpp.payment_exception.resolved_at.description: Timestamp when the payment exception was resolved and closed.

lpp.payment_exception.resolution_time_mi.name: resolution_time_minutes
lpp.payment_exception.resolution_time_mi.description: Total elapsed time in minutes between exception detection and resolution, with observed values ranging from 30 to 120 minutes.

lpp.payment_exception.resolved_by_user.name: resolved_by_user
lpp.payment_exception.resolved_by_user.description: Role or user group responsible for resolving the exception, such as regional cash managers or accounts payable leads.

lpp.payment_exception.resolution_action.name: resolution_action
lpp.payment_exception.resolution_action.description: Action taken to resolve the exception, such as an automated repair process.

lpp.payment_exception.repair_touch_count.name: repair_touch_count
lpp.payment_exception.repair_touch_count.description: Number of manual or automated intervention attempts required to repair the payment exception.

lpp.payment_exception.repair_cost_amount.name: repair_cost_amount
lpp.payment_exception.repair_cost_amount.description: Monetary cost incurred to repair or resolve the payment exception.

lpp.payment_exception.status.name: status
lpp.payment_exception.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment exception, indicating whether it has been resolved.

lpp.payment_file.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.payment_file.file_uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each payment file record.

lpp.payment_file.file_name.name: file_name
lpp.payment_file.file_name.description: The name of the ISO pain.001 XML payment file generated for a specific account and date, following the naming convention pain001-{account}-{YYYYMMDD}.xml.

lpp.payment_file.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.payment_file.company_ref.description: Short code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that owns the payment file, such as a country-specific operating company or group holding entity.

lpp.payment_file.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.payment_file.account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the specific bank account from which the payment file was originated, indicating account type such as operating, payroll, or concentration accounts.

lpp.payment_file.status.name: status
lpp.payment_file.status.description: Current processing status of the payment file indicating whether it has been sent to the bank, received and acknowledged, or negatively acknowledged.

lpp.payment_file.routing_status.name: routing_status
lpp.payment_file.routing_status.description: Status indicating whether the payment file routing process has been completed through the payment infrastructure.

lpp.payment_file.total_count.name: total_count
lpp.payment_file.total_count.description: Total number of individual payment transactions included within the payment file.

lpp.payment_file.total_amount.name: total_amount
lpp.payment_file.total_amount.description: Aggregate monetary value of all payment transactions contained within the payment file.

lpp.payment_file.total_currency.name: total_currency
lpp.payment_file.total_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the total payment file amount is denominated.

lpp.payment_file.created_at.name: created_at
lpp.payment_file.created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the payment file record was first created in the system.

lpp.payment_file.updated_at.name: updated_at
lpp.payment_file.updated_at.description: Timestamp recording the most recent update to the payment file record, reflecting status changes or corrections.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each payment hub throughput record.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.metric_date.name: metric_date
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.metric_date.description: The calendar date for which the payment throughput metrics were captured.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.payment_rail.name: payment_rail
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.payment_rail.description: The payment network or rail over which transactions were processed, such as ACH, WIRE, RTP, or SEPA Credit Transfer.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.country.name: country
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.country.description: The country in which the payment transactions were originated or processed.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.originating_s.name: originating_system
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.originating_s.description: The source system that originated or submitted the payment transactions, such as the Kyriba Payment Hub.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.volume_count.name: volume_count
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.volume_count.description: The total number of payment transactions submitted for processing on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.value_amount.name: value_amount
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.value_amount.description: The total monetary value of all payment transactions processed on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.success_count.name: success_count
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.success_count.description: The number of payment transactions that were successfully processed on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.rejection_cou.name: rejection_count
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.rejection_cou.description: The number of payment transactions that were rejected or failed processing on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.repair_count.name: repair_count
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.repair_count.description: The number of payment transactions that required manual repair or intervention before processing on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.stp_rate_pct.name: stp_rate_pct
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.stp_rate_pct.description: The straight-through processing rate expressed as a percentage, representing the share of payments processed without manual intervention.

lpp.payment_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.payment_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual payment transaction record.

lpp.payment_transaction.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.payment_transaction.file_uuid.description: Identifier of the payment file or batch that contained this transaction, linking individual transactions to their originating submission.

lpp.payment_transaction.end_to_end_id.name: end_to_end_id
lpp.payment_transaction.end_to_end_id.description: Industry-standard end-to-end reference identifier (e.g. E2E-0000006423) that uniquely tracks a payment across all parties and systems involved in the transaction lifecycle.

lpp.payment_transaction.transaction_date.name: transaction_date
lpp.payment_transaction.transaction_date.description: The business date on which the payment transaction was initiated or value-dated.

lpp.payment_transaction.execution_date.name: execution_date
lpp.payment_transaction.execution_date.description: The date on which the payment was actually processed or settled by the bank or payment rail.

lpp.payment_transaction.status.name: status
lpp.payment_transaction.status.description: The processing outcome of the payment transaction, indicating whether it was successfully completed or rejected.

lpp.payment_transaction.reason_code.name: reason_code
lpp.payment_transaction.reason_code.description: Standardised rejection reason code (e.g. AC03 indicating an invalid creditor account number) provided when a payment is not successfully processed.

lpp.payment_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.payment_transaction.amount.description: The monetary value of the payment transaction in the denomination specified by the currency code.

lpp.payment_transaction.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.payment_transaction.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP) in which the payment transaction amount is denominated.

lpp.payment_transaction.issuer_name.name: issuer_name
lpp.payment_transaction.issuer_name.description: The internal legal entity or group company (e.g. GR_FR, GR_US_INC) that is the originator or payer of the payment transaction.

lpp.payment_transaction.issuer_account.name: issuer_account
lpp.payment_transaction.issuer_account.description: The internal bank account identifier of the issuing entity (e.g. GR_AU_OPERATING_1) from which the payment was debited.

lpp.payment_transaction.counterparty_nam.name: counterparty_name
lpp.payment_transaction.counterparty_nam.description: The name or category of the external party receiving the payment, such as Vendor, Payroll Provider, Tax Authority, or Landlord Holdings.

lpp.payment_transaction.counterparty_acc.name: counterparty_account
lpp.payment_transaction.counterparty_acc.description: The account identifier of the external payment recipient (e.g. TP_CAPEX_0001, TP_IT_0004), categorised by vendor type.

lpp.payment_transaction.reference.name: reference
lpp.payment_transaction.reference.description: A human-readable payment reference string (e.g. AP-00055555, RENT-GR_DE_OP_2-202305) used to identify the business purpose or source document such as an accounts payable invoice, rent, or tax payment.

lpp.payment_transaction.last_ack_time.name: last_ack_time
lpp.payment_transaction.last_ack_time.description: The timestamp of the most recent acknowledgement received from the payment network or bank confirming the transaction status.

lpp.payment_transaction.payment_rail.name: payment_rail
lpp.payment_transaction.payment_rail.description: The payment network or method used to process the transaction, such as WIRE, SEPA Credit Transfer, ACH, or Real-Time Payments.

lpp.peer_company.code.name: code
lpp.peer_company.code.description: Unique internal code identifying a peer company, typically matching its stock ticker symbol (e.g., WMT, TGT, AMZN).

lpp.peer_company.name.name: name
lpp.peer_company.name.description: Full legal or registered business name of the peer company (e.g., Walmart Inc., Amazon.com Inc.).

lpp.peer_company.ticker.name: ticker
lpp.peer_company.ticker.description: Stock exchange ticker symbol used to publicly identify the peer company (e.g., WMT, HD, AMZN).

lpp.peer_company.sector.name: sector
lpp.peer_company.sector.description: Broad industry sector classification of the peer company, such as Consumer Staples Retail or Consumer Discretionary / Cloud.

lpp.peer_company.peer_group.name: peer_group
lpp.peer_company.peer_group.description: Competitive peer group category to which the company belongs, used to group similar retail business models (e.g., BIG_BOX_RETAIL, GROCERY, ECOMMERCE).

lpp.peer_company.country.name: country
lpp.peer_company.country.description: Country of domicile or primary operations for the peer company, represented as an ISO country code (e.g., US).

lpp.peer_company_metric.peer_code.name: peer_code
lpp.peer_company_metric.peer_code.description: Stock ticker symbol identifying the peer company (e.g., WMT for Walmart, AMZN for Amazon, HD for Home Depot).

lpp.peer_company_metric.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.peer_company_metric.period_date.description: The start or end date of the financial reporting period to which the metrics apply.

lpp.peer_company_metric.period_type.name: period_type
lpp.peer_company_metric.period_type.description: Indicates whether the reported metrics cover a single quarter or a full fiscal year.

lpp.peer_company_metric.reporting_curren.name: reporting_currency
lpp.peer_company_metric.reporting_curren.description: The currency in which all monetary metrics for the peer company are reported (currently USD for all records).

lpp.peer_company_metric.revenue.name: revenue
lpp.peer_company_metric.revenue.description: Total net revenue or net sales reported by the peer company for the period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.ebitda.name: ebitda
lpp.peer_company_metric.ebitda.description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization reported by the peer company for the period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.free_cash_flow.name: free_cash_flow
lpp.peer_company_metric.free_cash_flow.description: Cash generated by the peer company's operations after capital expenditures for the period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.net_debt.name: net_debt
lpp.peer_company_metric.net_debt.description: Total debt minus cash and cash equivalents on the peer company's balance sheet at the end of the period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.leverage_ratio.name: leverage_ratio
lpp.peer_company_metric.leverage_ratio.description: A measure of the peer company's financial leverage, typically total debt relative to equity or earnings.

lpp.peer_company_metric.debt_to_ebitda.name: debt_to_ebitda
lpp.peer_company_metric.debt_to_ebitda.description: Ratio of the peer company's net debt to EBITDA, indicating how many years of earnings would be needed to repay debt.

lpp.peer_company_metric.return_on_capita.name: return_on_capital_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.return_on_capita.description: The peer company's return on invested capital expressed as a percentage, measuring capital efficiency.

lpp.peer_company_metric.dividend_yield_p.name: dividend_yield_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.dividend_yield_p.description: Annual dividends paid by the peer company as a percentage of its share price.

lpp.peer_company_metric.buyback_yield_pc.name: buyback_yield_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.buyback_yield_pc.description: Value of shares repurchased by the peer company expressed as a percentage of its market capitalization.

lpp.peer_company_metric.shareholder_retu.name: shareholder_return_yield_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.shareholder_retu.description: Combined return to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks expressed as a percentage of market capitalization.

lpp.peer_company_metric.wacc_pct.name: wacc_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.wacc_pct.description: The peer company's weighted average cost of capital expressed as a percentage, reflecting the blended cost of debt and equity financing.

lpp.peer_company_metric.payments_cost_pc.name: payments_cost_pct_revenue
lpp.peer_company_metric.payments_cost_pc.description: The peer company's total payments processing costs expressed as a percentage of revenue.

lpp.peer_company_metric.fraud_loss_bps.name: fraud_loss_bps
lpp.peer_company_metric.fraud_loss_bps.description: The peer company's fraud-related losses measured in basis points, indicating the rate of fraud relative to transaction volume or revenue.

lpp.peer_company_metric.interchange_pct.name: interchange_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.interchange_pct.description: The interchange fees incurred or earned by the peer company expressed as a percentage of payment transaction volume.

lpp.pension_plan.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.pension_plan.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each pension plan record.

lpp.pension_plan.code.name: code
lpp.pension_plan.code.description: Short alphanumeric business code identifying a pension plan, encoding country and plan type (e.g., PP_US_DB for the US defined-benefit plan).

lpp.pension_plan.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.pension_plan.company_ref.description: Business code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary company that sponsors the pension plan (e.g., GR_US_INC for the US incorporated entity).

lpp.pension_plan.plan_name.name: plan_name
lpp.pension_plan.plan_name.description: Full human-readable name of the pension plan as used in official plan documentation (e.g., GlobalRetail UK Pension Scheme).

lpp.pension_plan.plan_type.name: plan_type
lpp.pension_plan.plan_type.description: Classification of the pension plan structure, indicating whether it is a defined benefit, hybrid, or other arrangement.

lpp.pension_plan.country.name: country
lpp.pension_plan.country.description: ISO 2-letter country code indicating the jurisdiction in which the pension plan operates (e.g., US, GB, JP).

lpp.pension_plan.open_to_new_participant.name: open_to_new_participants
lpp.pension_plan.open_to_new_participant.description: Flag indicating whether the pension plan is currently accepting new member enrolments.

lpp.pension_valuation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.pension_valuation.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each pension valuation record for system-level tracking.

lpp.pension_valuation.plan_ref.name: plan_ref
lpp.pension_valuation.plan_ref.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific defined-benefit pension plan by country and type (e.g., PP_UK_DB for the UK defined-benefit plan).

lpp.pension_valuation.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.pension_valuation.as_of_date.description: The valuation date as of which the pension plan's financial position and actuarial assumptions are measured.

lpp.pension_valuation.projected_benefit_.name: projected_benefit_obligation
lpp.pension_valuation.projected_benefit_.description: The actuarial present value of all future pension benefits earned by employees to date, projected using estimated future salary levels.

lpp.pension_valuation.plan_assets_fair_v.name: plan_assets_fair_value
lpp.pension_valuation.plan_assets_fair_v.description: The fair market value of assets held in trust by the pension plan to fund future benefit payments.

lpp.pension_valuation.funded_status.name: funded_status
lpp.pension_valuation.funded_status.description: The net difference between plan assets at fair value and the projected benefit obligation, indicating whether the plan is overfunded (positive) or underfunded (negative).

lpp.pension_valuation.funded_status_pct.name: funded_status_pct
lpp.pension_valuation.funded_status_pct.description: The ratio of plan assets to the projected benefit obligation expressed as a percentage, indicating the degree to which the plan is funded.

lpp.pension_valuation.discount_rate_pct.name: discount_rate_pct
lpp.pension_valuation.discount_rate_pct.description: The interest rate used to discount projected future benefit payments to their present value in the actuarial valuation.

lpp.pension_valuation.expected_return_on.name: expected_return_on_assets_pct
lpp.pension_valuation.expected_return_on.description: The actuarially assumed long-term annual rate of return expected to be earned on pension plan assets.

lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.name: projected_contribution_y1
lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.description: The estimated employer cash contribution to the pension plan projected for the first year following the valuation date.

lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.name: projected_contribution_y2
lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.description: The estimated employer cash contribution to the pension plan projected for the second year following the valuation date.

lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.name: projected_contribution_y3
lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.description: The estimated employer cash contribution to the pension plan projected for the third year following the valuation date.

lpp.pension_valuation.oci_impact.name: oci_impact
lpp.pension_valuation.oci_impact.description: The net actuarial gain or loss and prior service cost recognized in Other Comprehensive Income resulting from changes in pension valuation assumptions or experience.

lpp.pension_valuation.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.pension_valuation.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the pension plan's financial values are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, JPY).

lpp.pos_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.pos_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each point-of-sale transaction record.

lpp.pos_transaction.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.pos_transaction.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or country-specific subsidiary under which the transaction was recorded (e.g., GR_MX for the Mexican entity, GR_US_INC for the US entity).

lpp.pos_transaction.channel.name: channel
lpp.pos_transaction.channel.description: The sales channel through which the transaction was completed, such as in-warehouse, e-commerce, kiosk, mobile app, or membership renewal.

lpp.pos_transaction.location_code.name: location_code
lpp.pos_transaction.location_code.description: Identifier for the physical warehouse or store location where the transaction took place, following a country-and-sequence format (e.g., WH_US_0039 for US warehouse #39).

lpp.pos_transaction.transaction_ts.name: transaction_ts
lpp.pos_transaction.transaction_ts.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which the point-of-sale transaction occurred.

lpp.pos_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.pos_transaction.amount.description: The monetary value of the transaction in the applicable currency.

lpp.pos_transaction.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.pos_transaction.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the transaction amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

lpp.pos_transaction.payment_method.name: payment_method
lpp.pos_transaction.payment_method.description: The method of payment used by the customer to complete the transaction, such as card, cash, mobile wallet, gift card, or check.

lpp.pos_transaction.member_id.name: member_id
lpp.pos_transaction.member_id.description: The unique identifier of the membership account associated with the transaction; null when the transaction is not linked to a member.

lpp.pos_transaction.register_id.name: register_id
lpp.pos_transaction.register_id.description: The identifier of the physical or virtual register terminal that processed the transaction (e.g., REG-06).

lpp.sme_feedback_session.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.sme_feedback_session.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each SME feedback session record.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.sme_user.name: sme_user
lpp.sme_feedback_session.sme_user.description: Identifier for the subject matter expert (SME) who participated in the feedback session.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.interviewer_use.name: interviewer_user
lpp.sme_feedback_session.interviewer_use.description: Identifier for the interviewer or facilitator who conducted the feedback session with the SME.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.started_at.name: started_at
lpp.sme_feedback_session.started_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the SME feedback session began.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.ended_at.name: ended_at
lpp.sme_feedback_session.ended_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the SME feedback session concluded.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.topic.name: topic
lpp.sme_feedback_session.topic.description: The subject or topic area covered during the SME feedback session.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.transcript_uri.name: transcript_uri
lpp.sme_feedback_session.transcript_uri.description: URI or file path pointing to the stored transcript of the SME feedback session.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each transcript chunk record.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.session_uuid.name: session_uuid
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.session_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the session to which this transcript chunk belongs.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.chunk_index.name: chunk_index
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.chunk_index.description: Sequential position of this chunk within its parent session transcript, indicating the order in which chunks appear.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.text.name: text
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.text.description: The actual transcript text content of this chunk, representing a segment of the session conversation or speech.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.opensearch_doc_.name: opensearch_doc_id
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.opensearch_doc_.description: The document identifier used to reference this transcript chunk in the OpenSearch index for full-text and vector search.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.embedding_model.name: embedding_model
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.embedding_model.description: The name or version of the machine learning model used to generate the vector embedding for this transcript chunk.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.embedded_at.name: embedded_at
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.embedded_at.description: The timestamp indicating when the vector embedding was generated and stored for this transcript chunk.

lpp.stress_run_result.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.stress_run_result.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each stress test run result record.

lpp.stress_run_result.scenario_ref.name: scenario_ref
lpp.stress_run_result.scenario_ref.description: Code identifying the stress scenario applied in this run, such as a top customer default, FX shock, interest rate increase, or accounts receivable drop.

lpp.stress_run_result.run_date.name: run_date
lpp.stress_run_result.run_date.description: Month-end timestamp indicating when the stress test was executed or the reporting period to which results apply.

lpp.stress_run_result.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.stress_run_result.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or group company for which the stress test result was computed.

lpp.stress_run_result.breach_date.name: breach_date
lpp.stress_run_result.breach_date.description: Projected date on which the entity's cash position is expected to breach the minimum threshold under the stress scenario; null when no breach is projected.

lpp.stress_run_result.min_projected_cash.name: min_projected_cash
lpp.stress_run_result.min_projected_cash.description: Minimum projected cash balance for the entity over the stress scenario horizon, expressed in the reporting currency.

lpp.stress_run_result.threshold_amount.name: threshold_amount
lpp.stress_run_result.threshold_amount.description: Minimum cash balance threshold (400 million) below which a stress breach is triggered, expressed in the reporting currency.

lpp.stress_run_result.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.stress_run_result.currency_code.description: ISO currency code in which monetary values for the stress run result are denominated, currently USD across all records.

lpp.stress_run_result.breach_severity.name: breach_severity
lpp.stress_run_result.breach_severity.description: Severity classification of the stress outcome, indicating whether the scenario results in no breach or a warning-level breach of the cash threshold.

lpp.stress_scenario.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.stress_scenario.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each stress scenario record.

lpp.stress_scenario.code.name: code
lpp.stress_scenario.code.description: Short machine-readable code uniquely naming a stress scenario, such as a receivables drop, FX shock, rate shift, customer default, or counterparty downgrade (e.g., STR_AR_DROP_20, STR_RATE_PLUS_200).
value_aliases: STR_AR_DROP_30_60D -> AR Receipts Drop 30% for 60 Days

lpp.stress_scenario.description.name: description
lpp.stress_scenario.description.description: Human-readable narrative explaining the nature and magnitude of the stress scenario (e.g., 'AR receipts drop 20% for 30 days', 'Rates +200bp parallel shift').

lpp.stress_scenario.scenario_type.name: scenario_type
lpp.stress_scenario.scenario_type.description: Category classifying the stress scenario into a broad risk type such as receipts drop, FX shock, rate shock, customer default, or bank downgrade.

lpp.stress_scenario.parameters.name: parameters
lpp.stress_scenario.parameters.description: Structured JSON object containing the specific quantitative and qualitative parameters that define how the stress scenario is applied (e.g., shock magnitude, duration, affected entities).

lpp.stress_scenario.created_at.name: created_at
lpp.stress_scenario.created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the stress scenario definition was created in the system.

lpp.sweep_execution.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.sweep_execution.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each sweep execution record.

lpp.sweep_execution.instruction_ref.name: instruction_ref
lpp.sweep_execution.instruction_ref.description: Reference code identifying the sweep instruction rule that triggered this execution, encoding region, entity, account type, and sequence (e.g. SW_GR_CA_OPERATING_1).

lpp.sweep_execution.execution_date.name: execution_date
lpp.sweep_execution.execution_date.description: Calendar date on which the sweep was executed.

lpp.sweep_execution.source_account_ref.name: source_account_ref
lpp.sweep_execution.source_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the account from which funds were swept (the originating account).

lpp.sweep_execution.target_account_ref.name: target_account_ref
lpp.sweep_execution.target_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the concentration or investment account to which swept funds were transferred.

lpp.sweep_execution.swept_amount.name: swept_amount
lpp.sweep_execution.swept_amount.description: Monetary amount actually transferred from the source account to the target account during the sweep.

lpp.sweep_execution.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.sweep_execution.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the account and swept amount (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.sweep_execution.pre_sweep_balance.name: pre_sweep_balance
lpp.sweep_execution.pre_sweep_balance.description: Account balance in the source account immediately before the sweep was executed.

lpp.sweep_execution.post_sweep_balance.name: post_sweep_balance
lpp.sweep_execution.post_sweep_balance.description: Account balance in the source account immediately after the sweep was executed.

lpp.sweep_execution.residual_amount.name: residual_amount
lpp.sweep_execution.residual_amount.description: Amount intentionally left behind in the source account after the sweep, such as a minimum balance threshold (typically zero or a fixed retention amount like 200,000).

lpp.sweep_execution.status.name: status
lpp.sweep_execution.status.description: Outcome status of the sweep execution indicating whether it completed successfully, was skipped, or encountered a failure.

lpp.sweep_execution.cash_flow_uuid.name: cash_flow_uuid
lpp.sweep_execution.cash_flow_uuid.description: Unique identifier referencing the cash flow record generated for the debit leg of the sweep transaction.

lpp.sweep_execution.counter_cash_flow_uu.name: counter_cash_flow_uuid
lpp.sweep_execution.counter_cash_flow_uu.description: Unique identifier referencing the cash flow record generated for the credit leg (counter-entry) of the sweep transaction.

lpp.sweep_instruction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.sweep_instruction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each sweep instruction record.

lpp.sweep_instruction.code.name: code
lpp.sweep_instruction.code.description: Business code uniquely identifying a sweep instruction, typically encoding the sweep type, entity group, country, and account sequence (e.g., SW_GR_GB_OPERATING_1).

lpp.sweep_instruction.source_account_ref.name: source_account_ref
lpp.sweep_instruction.source_account_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the source account from which funds are swept, encoding entity group, country, and account type.

lpp.sweep_instruction.target_account_ref.name: target_account_ref
lpp.sweep_instruction.target_account_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the destination concentration or pooling account to which swept funds are transferred.

lpp.sweep_instruction.sweep_type.name: sweep_type
lpp.sweep_instruction.sweep_type.description: Classification of the cash sweep mechanism used, such as zero-balance, target-balance, notional pooling, or threshold-based sweeping.

lpp.sweep_instruction.direction.name: direction
lpp.sweep_instruction.direction.description: Indicates whether the sweep moves funds only upward to the concentration account or operates in both directions between source and target accounts.

lpp.sweep_instruction.target_balance.name: target_balance
lpp.sweep_instruction.target_balance.description: The desired end-of-day balance amount that the source account should maintain after a target-balance sweep is executed.

lpp.sweep_instruction.target_balance_ccy.name: target_balance_ccy
lpp.sweep_instruction.target_balance_ccy.description: ISO currency code denominating the target balance amount for the sweep instruction (e.g., EUR, GBP, USD).

lpp.sweep_instruction.threshold_amount.name: threshold_amount
lpp.sweep_instruction.threshold_amount.description: The minimum balance threshold that must be exceeded in the source account before a threshold-based sweep is triggered.

lpp.sweep_instruction.schedule_cron.name: schedule_cron
lpp.sweep_instruction.schedule_cron.description: Scheduling expression defining when the sweep instruction is executed, with the observed value indicating end-of-day execution.

lpp.sweep_instruction.priority.name: priority
lpp.sweep_instruction.priority.description: Numeric priority order used to determine the sequence in which sweep instructions are processed when multiple instructions are scheduled simultaneously.

lpp.sweep_instruction.active.name: active
lpp.sweep_instruction.active.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sweep instruction is currently enabled and available for execution.

lpp.sweep_instruction.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.sweep_instruction.effective_from.description: The calendar date from which the sweep instruction becomes valid and eligible for execution.

lpp.sweep_instruction.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.sweep_instruction.effective_to.description: The calendar date on which the sweep instruction expires and is no longer valid for execution; null indicates an open-ended instruction.

lpp.third_party.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.third_party.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each third-party record.

lpp.third_party.code.name: code
lpp.third_party.code.description: Business code assigned to each third party, such as a retail consumer aggregate code or a sequentially numbered customer code (e.g., TP_CUST_0001).

lpp.third_party.third_party_type.name: third_party_type
lpp.third_party.third_party_type.description: Classifies the third party as an organization or another legal entity type.

lpp.third_party.name.name: name
lpp.third_party.name.description: Full display name of the third party, such as a retail partner or aggregated consumer group (e.g., 'Macys Partner 1', 'Aggregated Retail Consumer').

lpp.third_party.name2.name: name2
lpp.third_party.name2.description: Secondary or alternative name for the third party, used when a second legal or trading name is required.

lpp.third_party.first_name.name: first_name
lpp.third_party.first_name.description: First name of the individual contact associated with the third party, applicable when the party is a person rather than an organization.

lpp.third_party.last_name.name: last_name
lpp.third_party.last_name.description: Last name or surname of the individual contact associated with the third party.

lpp.third_party.birth_date.name: birth_date
lpp.third_party.birth_date.description: Date of birth of the individual associated with the third party record, applicable for person-type parties.

lpp.third_party.hidden.name: hidden
lpp.third_party.hidden.description: Flag indicating whether the third party is hidden from standard user-facing views or lookups.

lpp.third_party.closure_date.name: closure_date
lpp.third_party.closure_date.description: Date on which the third party relationship was officially closed or deactivated.

lpp.third_party.creditor.name: creditor
lpp.third_party.creditor.description: Flag indicating whether the third party acts as a creditor (i.e., the company owes money to this party).

lpp.third_party.debtor.name: debtor
lpp.third_party.debtor.description: Flag indicating whether the third party acts as a debtor (i.e., this party owes money to the company).

lpp.third_party.non_resident.name: non_resident
lpp.third_party.non_resident.description: Flag indicating whether the third party is classified as a non-resident entity for regulatory or tax purposes.

lpp.third_party.corp_id_code.name: corp_id_code
lpp.third_party.corp_id_code.description: Corporate identification code assigned to the third party, such as a company registration or legal entity identifier.

lpp.third_party.other_identifier.name: other_identifier
lpp.third_party.other_identifier.description: Flexible structured field storing additional identifiers for the third party in a semi-structured format.

lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_id.name: creditor_tax_id
lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_id.description: Tax identification number used when the third party is acting as a creditor for tax reporting purposes.

lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_registratio.name: creditor_tax_registration_id
lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_registratio.description: Tax registration identifier for the third party in its role as a creditor, used for official tax filings.

lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_type.name: creditor_tax_type
lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_type.description: Classification of the tax regime or tax type applicable to the third party in its creditor role.

lpp.third_party.creditor_agent_instructi.name: creditor_agent_instruction
lpp.third_party.creditor_agent_instructi.description: Special handling or payment instruction provided for the creditor's agent when processing transactions.

lpp.third_party.link_number_ref.name: link_number_ref
lpp.third_party.link_number_ref.description: Reference code linking the third party to an associated account or record in an external system.

lpp.third_party.portfolio_ref.name: portfolio_ref
lpp.third_party.portfolio_ref.description: Reference to the portfolio to which this third party is assigned for grouping or management purposes.

lpp.third_party.folder_ref.name: folder_ref
lpp.third_party.folder_ref.description: Reference to an organizational folder or category used to group third parties in the system.

lpp.third_party.limit_currency_ref.name: limit_currency_ref
lpp.third_party.limit_currency_ref.description: Currency code used as the reference currency for evaluating transaction limits applied to the third party (e.g., EUR).

lpp.third_party.transaction_entry_limit.name: transaction_entry_limit
lpp.third_party.transaction_entry_limit.description: Maximum monetary amount allowed per individual transaction entry for this third party, expressed in the limit currency.

lpp.third_party.transaction_max_number.name: transaction_max_number
lpp.third_party.transaction_max_number.description: Maximum number of transactions permitted for this third party within a defined control period.

lpp.third_party.company_selection.name: company_selection
lpp.third_party.company_selection.description: Defines the scope of companies that can access or transact with this third party record.

lpp.third_party.used_by_company_ref.name: used_by_company_ref
lpp.third_party.used_by_company_ref.description: Reference to the specific company that has primary usage or ownership of this third party record.

lpp.third_party.used_by_companies.name: used_by_companies
lpp.third_party.used_by_companies.description: Structured list of all companies that are permitted to use or reference this third party record.

lpp.third_party.company_ownership_ref.name: company_ownership_ref
lpp.third_party.company_ownership_ref.description: Reference identifying the company that owns or is legally responsible for this third party record.

lpp.third_party.address.name: address
lpp.third_party.address.description: Structured address information for the third party, including street, city, country and postal details.

lpp.third_party.contact.name: contact
lpp.third_party.contact.description: Structured contact details for the third party, such as phone numbers and email addresses.

lpp.third_party.memo.name: memo
lpp.third_party.memo.description: Free-text notes or remarks recorded against the third party for internal reference purposes.

lpp.third_party.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.third_party.user_zones.description: Structured field storing user-defined zone or segmentation attributes associated with the third party.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.third_party_bank_account.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each third-party bank account record.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.third_party.name: third_party_code
lpp.third_party_bank_account.third_party.description: Code identifying the external third party (e.g., vendor, supplier, or counterparty) associated with this bank account.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.branch_ref.name: branch_ref
lpp.third_party_bank_account.branch_ref.description: Reference code identifying the bank branch associated with the third-party bank account.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.currency_re.name: currency_ref
lpp.third_party_bank_account.currency_re.description: Currency code indicating the denomination in which the third-party bank account operates.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.bank_accoun.name: bank_account_id
lpp.third_party_bank_account.bank_accoun.description: Structured composite identifier containing the details of the third-party bank account (e.g., account number, IBAN, or routing information).

lpp.third_party_bank_account.is_default.name: is_default
lpp.third_party_bank_account.is_default.description: Flag indicating whether this bank account is the default account used for payments to the associated third party.

lpp.working_capital_metric.revenue_ttm.name: revenue_ttm

lpp.working_capital_metric.cogs_ttm.name: cogs_ttm
